projects.title: Show HN: Belay – formal verification for SQLite migrations and queries in Lean 4
projects.author: neprotivo
projects.summary: Hi, I'm Tzanko and I'm the author of Belay. Belay is a Lean 4 library for doing formal verification of SQLite queries and migrations. It implements a semantic model of a subset of SQLite, validated by differential tests that compare the output against native SQLite. With Belay I wanted to see how difficult it is to use formal verification for everyday development tasks. It turns out it can be made not much harder than writing an integration test: you state the claim, the agent writes the proof, and Lean's kernel checks it, so the only thing you have to read is the claim (longer write-up on the motivation and agent workflow: https://vihren.dev/blog/20261112-belay/ ). While a migration is being written, your agent can run #sql_check, which searches small databases for counterexamples to a claim, and is as easy to run as a linter. Once the migration is settled, the agent writes a proof of the claims you need, for example that the migration preserves the results of existing queries and succeeds on valid data. Currently Belay supports a subset of SQLite 3.51.0, cross-checked against native SQLite on 5,768 differential test cases, most of which come from SQLite's own test suite. Unsupported SQL is rejected with a reason and never approximated. Not every rule of the model has had a human audit yet. The model covers single-connection operational semantics only: it says nothing about query plans, locks, concurrency or crash behavior. I think this approach can make formal verification as routine as testing, though two things stand in the way. The first is coverage: the model has to cover the full semantics of SQLite and all of its recent versions, and the same work has to be done for other engines such as PostgreSQL and ClickHouse. The second is proof cost: the proofs of common claims are still long for the agent to write, and they have to become short. I'm looking for design partners who want this for their workloads on SQLite or other open-source databases, because a real workload is the best guide to what to cover first. The models that come out of that work become part of Belay as open source. Reach out at contact@vihren.dev. If you know a tricky SQLite edge case where the model might diverge from native SQLite, or a gnarly migration bug you've hit in production, I'd love to test it and hear your thoughts.

It turned out it wasn't as easy as just prompting it, but I spent time building the system so it works almost every time. And I am pretty sure you are seeing a bunch of people posting weekend vibe-coded apps and saying "$50K/month after quitting my McDonnalds job...". Well, even my friend tried to fake it a few months back. So, I kinda did this fakemetrics.com as an experiment to see how well I can have the system that clones UIs, and packaged that as a very simple (I think) usable product for the people that want to be a superstar "build in public" type of a person with no revenue, but a perfect Stripe user growth screenshot. Useful? - Probably not that much Fun? - YES!! The best part is that Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok models aren't that good at UI clones by default, but with fakemetrics.com I kinda made a system that produces near-identical results from screenshots fairly fast. That was worth learning! Let me know what you think? Should I move on with the UI cloning as an open-source product?

projects.title: 爬了 X 和 LinkedIn，专门收集 hiring manager 发的 AI 招聘贴
projects.author: SupDigitalOcean
projects.summary: 做了个站点，专门抓取 X 和 LinkedIn 上 hiring manager 发布的 AI 招聘贴，同步各家公司官网岗位。顺便基于全量岗位数据做了份 AI 招聘大盘，帮大家看清当下的招人趋势。 体验地址: https://cookllm.com 为什么专门盯 hiring manager 的帖子？主要有三点： 1. 机会更稀缺，竞争更小。很多 AI 团队扩招时，hiring manager 会先在社交平台发帖捞人，不少岗位不会走官网正式招聘流程。等岗位同步到公开招聘渠道，投递池已经堆了几百份简历，直招帖的竞争小很多。 2. 没有套话。官网 JD 大多是标准化模板，职责和要求写得大而空，看不出团队真实在做什么、急缺什么方向。hiring manager 直发的帖子往往会讲清具体项目、核心痛点和真实用人偏好，参考价值高很多。 3. 手动刷实在太低效。来回切换 X、LinkedIn，搜关键词、翻时间线，刷一晚上也攒不了几个匹配的，还很容易漏掉新出的岗位，纯浪费时间。 索性写了脚本把这类招聘贴统一抓取汇总，同时持续巡检各家公司招聘门户，两类岗位整合在一起： - 实时抓取 X / LinkedIn 上 hiring manager 发布的直招帖 - 持续巡检企业招聘官网，岗位上线第一时间捕获 - 上传简历可评估匹配度，标出重合技能与能力缺口 - 支持按地区、工作模式、职级筛选，投递直达公司官网 - 可订阅每日匹配岗位推送，不用自己蹲守更新 另外想顺便分享一个配套做的东西。AI 这行迭代太快，招聘要求和招人方向一直在变。不管是准备入行、转方向还是规划学习，都很容易摸不准当下真实的市场需求，踩错方向白忙活。 所以我们基于抓取的全量岗位数据，做了一份 AI 招聘大盘，能直观看到当前市场在招哪些方向的人才、哪些细分领域热度在变化、不同级别的核心技能要求有什么趋势。 岗位看板和招聘大盘都免费开放，所有岗位都能正常浏览、筛选、跳转官网申请。 体验地址: https://cookllm.com 欢迎大家试用，有任何问题或者功能建议，都可以随时反馈。

projects.title: Show HN: Heardloom – Preserve immigrant family stories before they're lost
projects.author: westdragon
projects.summary: I built Heardloom ( https://heardloom.com ) to help immigrant families capture their life stories before they're lost. My parents immigrated from China, and I believe all immigrants have extraordinary stories. Leaving behind everyone you know to start over in an unfamiliar country makes you a risk-taker almost by definition. Yet, I know very little of my family stories. To be honest, my Chinese was never good enough to truly understand the fine details of their stories. I know that my grandma's mom died when she was a child, but I don't know her emotions or how it affected her relationship with her dad. I don't know how she became a factory engineer - what inspired her and how she developed her interests. I'll never know either. My grandma passed away unexpectedly. She practically raised my sister and me while my parents worked 80+hr weeks to provide for us. I spent over a decade with her, and I'll spend the rest of my life regretting that I never truly got to know her. I just had my own kids, and I want to make sure they know where they come from and their family's extraordinary stories. I wanted something like Storyworth or Remento, but they were only in English and too hard for my parents to use. That's why I made Heardloom. My family can have casual conversations in Chinese to Lana (named after my grandma). All of the stories get translated to English and turned into a family book. I also get to share my stories and photos to my family, so they get to see my life now in America. I would love any feedback, and I'm happy to help anyone get set up. This would make the perfect gift over the holidays for any parents or grandparents.

projects.title: 自己是围棋新手，于是做了一个讲清“为什么这样下”的开源围棋学习网站
projects.author: MinjiaHu
projects.summary: 大家好，分享一个最近做的项目：**The Go Room**，一个面向零基础学习者的围棋网页。 我自己就是围棋新手。知道了一点规则，真正跟电脑下的时候，还是一直被吃棋，而且不知道哪里下错了。 所以我想做一个能陪新手慢慢看懂每一步的地方。 **[在线体验](https://minjia-hu.github.io/the-go-room/) · [GitHub 源码](https://github.com/Minjia-Hu/the-go-room)** ![The Go Room 首页：纸色、墨色与朱红的国风界面](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Minjia-Hu/the-go-room/main/docs/images/home.png) ### 先试一下，再看为什么 比如一块棋快被吃了，向外接一颗，看起来像是在逃跑，但真的救出来了吗？ 你可以先试这个下法，看看对方回应之后发生什么；再换成提子救棋，比较两种选择，最后试着回答原因。答错之后会有解释，也允许重新尝试。 下面这段演示就是：**向外接一颗，还是被吃了；换成提子，再看看为什么能救出来。** ![救棋练习演示：试下、观察被提、换一种救法，再回答原因](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Minjia-Hu/the-go-room/main/docs/images/practice-demo.gif) ### 目前能做什么 - **学**：从落子、气和提子开始，逐步学习救棋、连接、两眼、围地与终局。 - **练**：22 道练习，按能力分类，看不懂时可以回到对应讲解。 - **弈**：与简单电脑对手下九路棋。默认开启陪练，先试下、看提示，再确认，也可以退回最近一回合重试。 - **复**：保存已完成的棋谱，逐手回看提子等过程。 界面用了纸色、墨色和朱红，希望学棋的过程能安静一点。打开网页就能用，不需要注册，没有付费课程，学习进度和棋谱保存在当前浏览器中。 技术上是 React + TypeScript + Vite，纯前端，无后端，以 MIT 许可证开源。 目前电脑对手比较简单，提示主要解释局部后果；终局时需要自己标记死子，程序不会自动核验死活。 很想听听大家的实际体验： - **如果你也是新手**：哪一句讲解看不懂？哪道题做完后，还是不知道为什么？ - **如果你会下围棋**：有没有题目或解释不够准确，容易让初学者产生误解？ 欢迎[打开试试](https://minjia-hu.github.io/the-go-room/)。如果哪一步让你觉得“还是没看懂”，欢迎在评论里告诉我，或到 [GitHub](https://github.com/Minjia-Hu/the-go-room) 提 Issue，我会继续改进。

projects.title: 用 AI 和网站引擎搭了个 Suzy Says 英文攻略站，想请大家看看
projects.author: zkitkevin
projects.summary: 最近在尝试做英文游戏攻略站，刚把一个围绕 Suzy Says 的小站上线： https://suzysays.co/ Suzy Says 是 MOONBIT 做的一款恐怖游戏。我这边做的是非官方攻略站，主要整理官方下载入口、新手说明和结局相关资料。 这次用了 AI 配合网站引擎，从查搜索结果、确定页面内容，到写页面、预览和发布，完整走了一遍。 过程中有两件事让我印象比较深。 一开始想做成首页直接玩的游戏站，但核实后发现，作者官方提供的是 Windows 下载版。网上虽然有些页面写着“在线玩 Suzy Says”，继续查它实际加载的游戏地址，却发现其中一个嵌入的是另一款游戏。所以最后改成了攻略和官方下载指引，没有硬塞一个播放器进去。 另一个是结局资料。不同视频和攻略对 Good、True、Bad 的叫法不完全一致，有些触发条件也互相矛盾。现在的处理方式是把开发者明确确认的信息和视频作者的说法分开，附上来源，不把没验证过的步骤写成确定的通关教程。 目前主要做了三个页面： - 首页：官方下载入口、操作和版本区别。 - 新手指南：尽量不剧透，给第一次玩的人看。 - 结局参考：整理名称差异、Full 版要求和相关视频，剧透提示可以展开。 站点部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上，页面通过引擎生成，支持预览后再发布。中间还遇到一个引擎检查默认要求首页必须绑定游戏的问题，后来补了攻略首页模式才顺利上线。 想请大家帮忙看看几个地方： 1. 第一眼能不能看懂这是一个什么站？ 2. 页面导航和文章入口是否好找？ 3. 如果你是搜这个游戏进来的，还希望看到什么内容？ 英文表达、页面体验或者资料准确性有问题，也欢迎直接指出来

projects.title: Show HN: SecureVibe – Find and trace vulnerabilities before shipping
projects.author: Abdo2026
projects.summary: Hello HN, just wanted to share my project that I've been working on the past months, where I noticed the issue that now we ship faster than setting up the requirements for the project. So I thought of building secureVibe to find vulnerabilities in your codebase. Now I have a MVP where it doesn't just scan the code and show random analysis I used Tree-sitter and AST to understand code context to validate vulnerabilities found as it builds a graph of application routes, handlers and database calls so it helps to determine whether findings are confirmed or likely. Briefly the features: 1- shows all vulnerabilities in your code with code snippets 2-fixing with ai option (optional with your own api key for now) 3- ask the graph feature as you can ask where the attacker can exploit my website or authentication issues (I used graphify as foundation for it ) 4- You can filter vulnerabilities categories (like Cwe, database injection and more) from dashboard and you can download it as html report simple interactive one so you can fix it on your own later. I would love to know your thoughts and feedback to continue on the development on it like some of the problems I faced is benchmarks to validate security rules. With some research I found openssf benchmark On the OpenSSF CVE benchmark, the raw F1 score was 77.5, but still I face some issues with false positive so would really appreciate feedback to continue on developing with next phases. Even though with these issues Its still working well, it is efficient and fast and preferably start with TypeScript repos first for it.

projects.title: 历时 15 天, 经过 108 次版本迭代, 我给 OpenWrt 做了一款 本地 DNS 服务器: updns
projects.author: investor
projects.summary: 最初我的需求只是网络走哪里，DNS 就跟着走哪里，这符合网络流量最短路径. 因此 基于域名匹配的 DNS 路由、 `NFT set`联动要被作为核心实现. 现在历时 15 天, 经过 108 次版本迭代, 我做成了它. 与`dnsmasq`不同的是，`updns` 提供了更灵活的 DNS 路由、 `NFT set`联动，除此之外它还支持 `DoT`、`DoH` 且拥有强大的 `主动预取`、 `广告拦截` 和 `DNS 审计` 能力。 与`smartdns`不同的是，`updns` 在 OpenWrt 上提供了更简洁清晰的 Luci 交互、更严谨的 `NFT set`联动, 除此之外, `updns` 尊重本地网络, 不做 IP 端点 速度探测, 因为当下 运营商 提供的 DNS 在国内大部分网络已经路径最优, `updns` 做的是 获取本地解析文件, 自动将运营商 DNS 纳入可自行选择的上游之一. 这里说的有点多, 因为此前我也是 `smartdns` 用户, `smartdns` 做的也不错, 但是现在我放弃了它. 来展示, 哈哈哈: ```txt OpenWrt → ~ # ping www.baidu.com PING www.baidu.com (2409:8c00:6c21:11eb:0:ff:b0bf:59ca): 56 data bytes 64 bytes from 2409:8c00:6c21:11eb:0:ff:b0bf:59ca: seq=0 ttl=55 time=5.535 ms 64 bytes from 2409:8c00:6c21:11eb:0:ff:b0bf:59ca: seq=1 ttl=55 time=5.462 ms 64 bytes from 2409:8c00:6c21:11eb:0:ff:b0bf:59ca: seq=2 ttl=55 time=5.397 ms 64 bytes from 2409:8c00:6c21:11eb:0:ff:b0bf:59ca: seq=3 ttl=55 time=5.507 ms 64 bytes from 2409:8c00:6c21:11eb:0:ff:b0bf:59ca: seq=4 ttl=55 time=5.366 ms 64 bytes from 2409:8c00:6c21:11eb:0:ff:b0bf:59ca: seq=5 ttl=55 time=5.126 ms 64 bytes from 2409:8c00:6c21:11eb:0:ff:b0bf:59ca: seq=6 ttl=55 time=5.305 ms ^C --- www.baidu.com ping statistics --- 7 packets transmitted, 7 packets received, 0% packet loss round-trip min/avg/max = 5.126/5.385/5.535 ms ``` 下面是 DNS 审计功能, 在 OpenWrt 你可以通过 updns 命令, 清晰获取指定域名 匹配的规则、选择的上游、加入了哪个 NFT Set 、解析结果是怎样: ```text root@OpenWrt:~# updns google.com ╭─ updns ──────────────────────────────────────────╮ │ │ DOMAIN │ ────────────────────────────────────────────── │ Domain : google.com. │ Query Type : A / AAAA │ Query Path : Cache Hit │ │ DNS RESULT │ ────────────────────────────────────────────── │ Matched Rule : US Access │ Upstream : A=Google-DoH / AAAA=Google-DoH │ Action : IPv4 + IPv6 │ Response : NOERROR │ │ NFT SETS │ ────────────────────────────────────────────── │ IPv4 : inet/fw4/us4 │ ✓ Contains resolved IPv4 │ IPv6 : inet/fw4/us6 │ ✓ Contains resolved IPv6 │ │ ANSWERS │ ────────────────────────────────────────────── │ • 142.251.219.142 │ • 2607:f8b0:4005:818::200e │ ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────╯ ``` 广告拦截 功能当然也有了, 你要做的只是把需要屏蔽的站点域名放入一个文件, 让 updns 来使用它, 下面我通过日志功能来展示它: ```txt Sat Nov 14 17:16:51 2026 daemon.info updns[18922]: QUERY [CLI] ad.xiaomi.com. A → AD Blocked → ZERO-IP RULE → NOERROR Sat Nov 14 17:16:51 2026 daemon.info updns[18922]: QUERY [CLI] ad.xiaomi.com. AAAA → AD Blocked → ZERO-IP RULE → NOERROR ``` 如上, 我定义了一个名为 AD Blocked 的规则, 它匹配指定域名列表文件, ad.xiaomi.com 在这个文件中; 由于该规则指定了 ZERO-IP 返回, 于是 ad.xiaomi.com 的 DNS 解析会被拦截, 并以 ZERO-IP 返回, 最终客户端拿到的解析结果是: 0.0.0.0 / ::. 除了 ZERO-IP , updns 也支持 NXDOMAIN 拦截. 下面是, 如何安装, 对于 OpenWrt 25.12, 我提供了官方软件源, 通过下面命令可以便利安装: ```sh # 下载软件源签名公钥 wget -O /tmp/updns-public.pem https://downloads.garinasset.com/updns/openwrt/signing.pem # 核对公钥 SHA-256 sha256sum /tmp/updns-public.pem # 安装公钥 cp /tmp/updns-public.pem /etc/apk/keys/updns.pem # 配置软件源 ARCH="$(apk --print-arch)" echo "https://downloads.garinasset.com/updns/openwrt/25.12/${ARCH}/packages.adb" >> /etc/apk/repositories.d/customfeeds.list # 更新软件源并安装软件包 apk update apk add updns luci-app-updns luci-i18n-updns-zh-cn ``` 对于历史版本, 可以查看 官方 指南 手动编译安装. 以上, 除介绍以外, 还有一些实用且强大的功能, 包括缓存 主动预取, 因为迫切想让大家使用体验, 我就不过多展开了. 对了, updns 我给它的官方取名是 道岔 DNS, 想象像铁路道岔一样, updns 可以让你对 DNS 解析拥有更灵活的控制能力。 开放源代码: - [GitHub 软件仓库]( https://github.com/garinasset/updns) - [使用指南]( https://github.com/garinasset/updns/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md)

projects.summary: 正如标题所见的, Steam 游戏有所谓低价区 Netflix 有所谓低价区. --- 2010 年前后,南美区的账号几乎是 steam 玩家标配. 阿根廷人在贴吧熙熙攘攘. 购买游戏省一大笔钱,让你轻松具备国际视野(收获南美同志的友谊) --- 2026 年,吃着咖喱的印度同事会安利 youtube/netflix 会员在印度的订阅价格, 他们自豪的告诉我一年可以省下 100 多澳币. “weihy node?” --- 所以 indie dev 不妨学习这些大公司的思路. 对自己的产品,不管是 app 还是 iap 或者 saas. 让地主老财和穷苦欠发达地区收取不同费用. --- 所以 写了这个插件, 后来觉得插件还是太烦, 直接上 javascript 复制到书签就能用. [用 big mac index 给你的 ios app 和 iap item 定价]( https://bigmacindex.app/app-store-pricing-advisor/) ios 进行 appstore,直接就可以自动计算了. ![全自动自动定价]( https://bigmacindex.app/videos/big-mac-pricing-fill-10s.gif) --- 总而言之,用的经济学人的大麦克指数. (其实更好的是 ppp 购买力算过来,其实国内人民币还是被刻意压低了. 根据全球贫富差距和经济水平给你的产品合理定价. 比如你可以给中东石油王爷们收取和美国一样高的费用. 同时相对的,你也可以选择狠狠压榨瑞典的骑士贵族姥爷们 (因为老爷们发部分已经习惯了什么都很贵,你的一天伙食费很可能只有他们的一杯咖啡.) 大概就是这个思路吧. 欢迎提意见和批评.

projects.title: [开源推荐] Folio：本地优先的 Windows + Android 双端阅读器
projects.author: flulwh

github.name: flulwh/folio
github.description: 极简沉浸式电子书阅读器：Electron + React 桌面端 + Kotlin/Compose Android 客户端，局域网同步阅读进度与痕迹

projects.summary: Folio 是我自己每天在用的阅读器：桌面端 Electron + React，安卓端是原生 Kotlin + Jetpack Compose。它只把「读一本书」这件事做干净——书架就是首页，点开即读，工具栏随滚动淡出；进度按段落锚定，换字号、换栏宽之后仍回到原来那一句。两端不需要账号，同一 Wi-Fi 下桌面端开一个只监听内网的 HTTP 服务，手机填地址加 6 位访问码即可接入，阅读进度、书签、划线、笔记双向同步。没有云端、没有中转、不托管任何内容。 亮点 为长文阅读打磨的排版 虚拟滚动：几十万段的长篇只渲染视口附近的段落，滚动不掉帧；段落高度按「书 + 排版 + 栏宽」缓存到 localStorage（Uint16 + base64，长篇也存得下），第二次打开直接命中，不再整本重排。 中文排印细节：text-wrap: pretty 处理尾行孤字、hanging-punctuation 让句读悬挂、palt 收紧标点；字号、行距、栏宽、段距、首行缩进、字体族都能调，也能装自己的 ttf/otf/woff2（安装时就告诉你含不含中文）。 正则章节识别：「第X章 / Chapter N / 序章 / 楔子 / 【标题】」开箱可用，也能在设置里写自己的正则；目录支持章节搜索与当前章高亮。 痕迹按段落锚定：书签、划线、笔记在换字号、换栏宽后不会错位；页边一道朱砂短竖线标记书签。 自动滚动四档速度（15/25/40/60 px/s），[ ] 随时调速，滚轮一碰立刻交回手感。 双端同步：只走局域网，不上云 桌面端只用 Node 内置 http 起面板，零依赖、不增加打包体积，只监听内网；6 位访问码可一键更换。 同步阅读进度、书签、划线、笔记与书源配置；冲突按 updatedAt 新者胜、字段浅合并，不打断两边正在进行的滚动。 手机浏览器也能直接读：本地书自动切章节目录，云端书的目录与正文由本机书源引擎现抓，翻章、拖进度条都能用。 断网不丢：顶部明说「有一处进度还没同步」，联网后自动补写；也可以关掉写入权限，让面板退化成纯看板。 原生安卓端，不是 WebView 套壳 Kotlin + Compose + Miuix（HyperOS 风格），阅读控制层是浮动圆角卡片，不挤压正文。 点正文两侧或按音量键翻页，到章末自动接下一章；本地书正文下到手机私有目录，锁屏、飞行模式都能读。 省电：没有前台服务、没有常驻通知、不轮询，阅读页只组合可见段落。 APK 约 12 MB，minSdk 26；版本线与桌面端独立（桌面 2.x / 安卓 3.x），可分开升级。 书源与边界 兼容「阅读」(Legado) 书源：订阅链接（legado://import/…）、本地 JSON、粘贴 JSON 都能导入；书源仓库可按单条 / 本页 / 整批导入，试搜结果按健康度排序，一键筛掉失效源。 云端阅读按 3 章一个窗口并行抓取，读到底自动续接；失败章节标占位、可一键重试，阅读位置不丢。 不内置书城、不代理、不托管内容：书源只是解析规则，正文只在用户机器与源站之间流动。 MIT；books.json / progress.json / marks.json 字段双端对齐，变更保持向前兼容。 截图或演示视频 桌面端： 安卓端： 更多截图（目录、自动滚动、书籍市场、深色主题、设置页）见 README： 快速开始 Windows 10/11 x64：在 Releases 下载 Folio-Setup-2.9.2.exe（推荐）或单文件便携版，双击即用，不写注册表。 Android 8.0+：下载 Folio-3.5.0 APK。 源码运行：桌面端 npm install && npm run dev（Vite 热更新 + Electron 窗口）；安卓端 cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug。 先看效果：装好后书架是空的，点「读示例《山居手记》」即可进入沉浸阅读。 连手机：桌面端 设置 → 网络 → 开启面板；手机 设置 → 桌面端连接 填地址和访问码，或点「搜索桌面端」。 适合谁 想把 TXT / Markdown 和阅读记录留在自己机器上，又需要在电脑和手机之间接着读的人。 已经在用 Legado 书源、希望桌面端也有同等阅读体验的人。 不适合：需要在线书城、云端书架、公网多设备同步的场景。

projects.title: Show HN: New In browser URL verification tool
projects.author: integrity_softw
projects.summary: This is an in web browser address bar URL authenticity verification tool using only a special redirection system attached to the subdomains of trustedurl.org For example, to check the authenticity of and visit the authenticated site, add .trustedurl.org after the Top-Level Domain. >getmonero.org.trustedurl.org Entered into the address bar, this resolves to >getmonero.org You can also just type in the domain name without the TLD >getmonero.trustedurl.org Which similarily resolves to >https://getmonero.org This of course also works with the protocol >https://getmonero.org.trustedurl.org >https://getmonero.trustedurl.org Now say an attacker were to make a phishing site getphished.org, and you were uncertain if it were authentic. In this case, just apply the same postfix to the suspect domain >getphished.org.trustedurl.org Which resolves to a connection error page, because it isn't in the authentic URL whitelist. So far only a few cryptocurrency exchanges simpleswap.io, trocador.app, bisq and wallets bitcoin.org, electrum.org, getmonero.org have been added to the whitelist, along with torproject.org, i2p.net, freenet.org, devuan.org, tails.net SimpleSwap cryptocurrency exchange >simpleswap.trustedurl.org >simpleswap.io.trustedurl.org TAILS OS >tails.trustedurl.org >tails.net.trustedurl.org Monero wallet >getmonero.org.trustedurl.org >getmonero.trustedurl.org There are many fake websites and URLs that closely resemble the real sites, and going on the wrong site can easily lead to getting scammed of money and downloading malware. Using this tool prevents this by providing an extra layer of security if one hasn't memorized the exact fully qualified domain.

projects.title: aimstack-sanzhidiji：纯 C 从零自研的本地 AI 全栈
projects.author: tanxiansheng221

projects.summary: 这是什么 一套完全从零自研的本地 AI 全栈：推理引擎、插件总线、爬虫、知识库、Web UI、训练管线，全部手写，AGPL-3.0 开源。没有 llama.cpp、没有 PyTorch（训练对账用完即弃，产物零外部运行时）、没有任何第三方依赖——每一层都是可审计的纯 C / 纯 stdlib 代码。 我们做了什么 纯 C 推理引擎：三值量化核（1.58-bit）+ SIMD 快路径，权重自定义 2-bit 打包格式（.aimw） 权重转换器：微软 BitNet 官方 gguf → .aimw，一条命令完成 插件总线：约 100 行 C 实现，caps.json 注册表 → 拉起 Python 插件 → JSON 信封通信；模型不感知插件，确定性路由决定调用 多引擎爬虫：bing/百度/360 并行 + Edge 渲染级联（JS 重站点自动升级渲染），robots.txt 遵守 + 质量五信号闸（残文长度/壳密度/句子结构/信息密度/菜单味），fail-closed 知识库：FTS5 全文索引 + 查重闸，中文维基 dump 自建（CC-BY-SA 署名） 本地 Web UI：纯 stdlib，127.0.0.1:8600，对话直答 / 知识库引答 / 联网搜索→爬取→入库→引答全链路 训练管线：无自动微分训练栈（手写反向传播，29 参数 selftest 对账相对误差 5.7e-7）、十科课程生成器、语料构建器 117 章研究日志：SIMD 逐位对账、投机解码熔核、负面结果档案全部公开 实测结果 | 项目 | 数字 | |---|---| | 三值核 SIMD 快路径 | 85.53 tok/s（从 2.08 优化 41 倍） | | BitNet b1.58-2B-4T 推理 | 3.20 tok/s（双工人；串行 1.99） | | 权重体积 | 0.87 GB（.aimw 格式） | | C/NumPy 逐位对账 | 全绿（差一个 bit 不许提交） | | HF 贪心解码对账 | 前 9 token 逐位一致 | 测试配置（就是一台 2018 年的老笔记本） | 部件 | 规格 | |---|---| | CPU | Intel Core i7-7500U @ 2.70GHz（2 核 4 线程，低压 U） | | 内存 | 8GB DDR4-2133 单通道 | | GPU | GeForce 940MX（太弱，弃用——整套栈纯 CPU） | | 系统 | Windows | 优势 1. 断供免疫：全栈自研零第三方依赖，断网可运行、自主可服务，关键路径全部 vendor 进自家仓库 2. 全层可审计：引擎到 UI 每一层一个下午能读完，bug 可定位 3. 硬件门槛极低：2018 年双核低压 U 就能跑 2B 模型，多核/AVX-512/大内存机器欢迎帮忙测上限（我们没条件验证） 4. 训练资产全公开：课程生成器、语料构建器、正负面结果一起发——负面结果档案可能是仓库里最值钱的部分 5. 诚实文化：自研分词器未完成全量验证就明说，第三方权重配套微软官方分词器 诚实边界 2B 是这套硬件的舒适上限 自研 152M 模型还在训练（免费云容器），权重未发布，管线与证据全公开 Windows 优先（渲染级联用 Edge），Linux 编译通过、级联需装 Chromium 7 分钟演示视频在 README 顶部（实机录屏：对话 / 知识库引答 / 联网全链）。AGPL-3.0，研究文档 CC-BY-NC，微软权重 MIT 归属声明见 NOTICE.md。

projects.title: [分享创造] 一个带来源分级与保鲜机制的海外项目数据集（41 项目 / 136 来源，开源 + 双语站）
projects.summary: 做这个小东西的起因很具体：在给自己查 2027 年 J-1 的资格，发现中文世界关于「打工度假 / 海外实习签证」的信息有一个系统性问题—— 把只对中国台湾、中国香港护照开放的项目，写成「中国公民可申请」。加拿大 IEC 、英国 YMS 、爱尔兰 WHA 、日本 WH 、韩国 H-1 都属于双边互惠协议，中国大陆护照不在名单内。这类错误在攻略、中介软文、AI 生成内容里反复出现。 于是我把它当成一个数据工程问题来做，而不是又一个攻略站。 是什么 开源数据集 + 一个双语静态站。41 个项目、21 个国家和地区、136 条来源，其中中国大陆护照可申 34 个、不可申 7 个（不可申的也明确收录，作为排除记录）。 站： https://eddieye1004.github.io/overseas-program-dataset/ 库： https://github.com/eddieye1004/overseas-program-dataset 怎么做的 1) schema 先行。每个项目一个 JSON ，字段定义在 data/schema.json ，护照资格是第一等公民（ passport_types 决定 90% 的结论）。 2) 来源分级 + CI 强制。每条来源标 primary/secondary ，并按域名分 A/B/C/D 四级：A 是移民局/使领馆/官方法规库，D 是百科、自媒体、商业博客。D 级出现即 CI 失败，全部来源都不到 A/B 级也失败。二手来源不能单独支撑硬性资格判定。 3) 保鲜靠台账而不是靠人记。每条记录带 last_verified 。scripts/track.py 按项目性质分档：窗口写死到具体日期的 90 天复核、其余 180 天，剩余不足 25% 提前标「即将到期」。 产物两份：tracking.json 给程序读，FRESHNESS.md 给人读。CI 每周一跑 --check ，超期即退出码 1 把构建打红；另有一个脚本把同一份台账同步成一张 issue （固定标题 + 固定标签，先搜后改，不刷屏），让「红了」这件事真的有人看到。 4) 配额四态化（刚做完的一轮）。原来是「整数或 null 」，而 null 同时兼指「无名额上限 / 官方设限额但未公布 / 还没查」三种，读的人分不出来——他根本不知道自己看到的那一格是「没有上限」还是「没查」。 现在改成一个必填的状态字段，四态：有具体配额 / 无配额 / 官方未公布数字 / 待核实。凡断言前三态都必须指向本项目已有的一条 primary 来源，指不出来就只能写「待核实」。当前分布 4 / 34 / 1 / 2 。 两条「待核实」我没有硬凑数字——一个是奥地利红白红卡高资质档，NAG 有联邦最高限额制度，但这一档是否在限额之内、当年数字多少，官网几个页面都查不到；一个是德国机会卡，法条只授权联邦政府可限量、本身不设数字，配套条例经查不存在。这两条就挂在待办清单里，不写成「无配额」。 现在的状态 validate 严格模式 0 错 0 警； 135 个 Python 测试； e2e 212 条断言；前端 tsc/smoke/build 全绿。 窗口日历也做成了硬分区：41 个项目里 3 个能给出官方已公布的日期、2 个只敢按往年规律推断、36 个无从判断——这 36 个里有 32 个本身就是滚动受理、没有固定窗口，其余可查的已逐个核查并在条目里写明卡点。推断与「无从判断」两块在页面上永不出现具体日期。 没有 star 数可以报，也没有用户量可以报——就是我自己在用的一个库。 想求什么反馈 1) 数据纠错入口刚上线（结构化 issue 表单，必填官方来源），最想要的是**挑错**：哪条资格写错了、哪条链接死了、哪个数字过期了。附上官方页面链接就行。 表单： https://github.com/eddieye1004/overseas-program-dataset/issues/new?template=data-correction.yml 2) 来源分级的标准是否合理——特别是「高校官方部门算 C 级、只能作旁证」这条，我拿不准是不是过于严格。 3) 如果你在做同类项目，想听你怎么解决「保鲜」这件事。 不做的事也写清楚：不代办、不做中介导流、不提供「你该申哪个」的建议。这是信息汇编，判断留给你自己。

projects.title: Show HN: Kapso – Iterative learning from enterprise data
projects.author: alirezamshi
projects.summary: Hey HN! We're Alireza and Majid building Leeroo ( https://leeroo.com/ ). Previously we’ve built AI systems for products with millions of users, including at LinkedIn and Meta. We’re now focusing on building AI systems for enterprise data. Today, we're open-sourcing Kapso ( https://github.com/Leeroo-AI/kapso ), an engine that runs experiments, deploys the best solution, and learns from every run. The nature of data work is iterative: investigate, form hypotheses, experiment, and improve based on what you learn. This bottom-up process is the only way to deliver meaningful outcomes quickly in large, messy enterprise data environments. Consultants gathering context in meetings or teams defining a business ontology upfront to fit into the data has no chance of execution, in quarters and sometimes years. An AI-native system should automate this process, compounding learning to each new investigation and implementation. For instance, one of our enterprise projects was moving a company off its old data estate onto a lakehouse with more than 30 source-system families, thousands of tables and transformations, and hundreds of BI reports. No individual or AI agent knew how that data estate was connected and operated. The only way to learn it was to investigate the company's repos, dbt models, documentation, and data itself and propose hypotheses about the estate, run experiments, and learn from them, until we understand how each system behaves and under which conditions. The iterative work goes beyond understanding how data and systems fit together, and the business operations. Building useful software is iterative too. Whether you’re optimizing a warehouse, building a lakehouse pipeline or predicting churn, you need to run experiments and learn what works best in that environment. As you deliver more projects, that know-how compounds, similar in principle to RL. RAGing documentation has little value until it has been tried in a specific environment and the consequences are learned. As with human engineering work, experimentation and learning should happen in a sandbox. We built Kapso for this kind of work, you give it an objective and success criteria, and it works towards an optimum solution that can be deployed on your stack. You can view a video walkthrough here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W4FHlza1fRs Here’s how it works… Kapso has a bank of lessons that are induced or deduced from the past experiments, and each carries a credence score, conditions on where it applies, and the evidence behind it. For each new experiment, an ideation module proposes ideas considering the earlier lessons, re-ranks them by expected return against the budget each would use, and sends the top-ranked ones to the implementor. Because the bank keeps learning from the past experiments in that environment, the proposed ideas are better suited to it than generic hypotheses from an LLM or RAG. Also, results of each experiment are verified by a verifier module that no experiment can access and cheat. As we’ve found when building such systems, sometimes the success criteria and evaluation tests need to be evolved. The experimentation modules can propose updates to the metrics and criteria for the verifier to approve or reject. After each run, learn() updates the bank of lessons’ scores and boundaries using the evidence from that run. Changes to the bank can also be A/B tested by running otherwise identical builds with the previous and updated banks. The bank is built on git, so you can share your experience with others, list the banks available to you, and update them (`kapso experience share/list/update` in CLI). The system is model-agnostic and coding-agent-agnostic. kapso.deploy(solution, target_stack) follows the same workflow, runs a shorter experimentation loop to adapt the best solution to the target stack (e.g. Docker, Modal, BentoCloud, LangGraph). Every domain has a harness to start from, you can write your own domain harness with /kapso:harness in the plugin or through CLI (kapso harness new <name>), and compound over that by running experimentations. We ran it on some public benchmarks and live competitions, with the following results… - Predictive modelling on relational databases: first on RelBench, Kumo AI (now Nvidia) and Stanford's benchmark, ahead of the best tabular foundation model ( https://star-project.stanford.edu/relbench/leaderboard/ ). This shows that keeping the learning in the harness-level can beat foundational table models. Updating a bank of lessons costs far less than retraining a tabular foundation model. - ML Engineering: First on OpenAI's MLE-bench at submission, still among the top open-source systems ( https://github.com/openai/mle-bench/pull/107 ). - AI competitions: ahead of the best agent the ALE-Bench authors at Sakana AI reported, and running autonomously at the live International Olympiad in AI 2026, above all 471 human contestants and in the top three AI systems ( https://ioai-official.org/ai-models-track/ioai%c2%b2-2026-re... ). We have a public bank for ML and Data at Leeroopedia ( https://leeroopedia.com/ ): around 100k pages extracted by experimenting on papers and repos, about 6M requests a month, about 28% from AI agents. If you are at a growing company with a complex data estate across multiple systems and functions, and your data and AI team is stretched, we would love to help! https://github.com/Leeroo-AI/kapso

projects.title: Show HN: Agent-plan a CLI that automatically commits your agent's plans
projects.author: ghmeier
projects.summary: After spending quite a bit of time using various coding agents and a workflow that uses markdown-based research/plan/handoff documents to hold context across sessions, I kept on running into an this question of how and where to store the generated markdown. The contents are usually useful for posterity and future projects in the same feature area. However, it felt burdensome for myself or reviewers to clutter up diffs with largeish markdown documents. This left me with a mess of uncommitted markdown and a waste of tokens having LLMs collate the documentation. I figured this was the perfect usecase for a small CLI tool and some hooks that automatically create and sync planning documentation for the team. That's how agent-plan got started. It uses an orphan git branch a worktree checkout and symlinks to keep all the planning files available from any branch. There's a claude and codex plugin that install a couple hooks to sync and commit any edits as they happen. Myself and my team have been using this for the last month or so, and have found that it really smooths out document-driven development. It's straightforward to hand off plans between people, and easy to reference all the older documentation. It also solves a small (but frequent) papercut I had where I'd have to remember file names to reference them in subsequent chats. Since agent-plan stores everything in consistent formatting with some added frontmatter metadata, it's really easily searchable with plain text search. I figure lots of teams might have a similar sort of problem and I could save you some time.

projects.title: Show HN: Armin – Modern Anki alternative with prerrequisite graphs
projects.author: ansanabria
projects.summary: okay, so a bit of context. back when i was studying at college, i was trying to optimize my learning process as much as possible, and i ended up discovering Anki and spaced-repetition as a concept. i ended up using Anki for quite a while and it did help me. i loved the concept... but i didn't like the app. it had me conflicted. on one hand, it allowed me to properly review the content from my classes (among other stuff), but on the other it had way too many quirks and complicated ways of handling things that i wasn't a fan of (in particular, the UX leaves a lot to be desired, although it has marginally improved in recent years). i ended up churning from Anki and just abandoning the practice of spaced repetition altogether. after some time, i ended up reading this article recommended by Justin Skycak https://lelouch.dev/blog/you-are-probably-not-dumb/ . the tldr is that knowledge has prerrequisites, and if you don't have them, you won't fully understand what you are trying to learn in the first place. and that was one of my annoyances with Anki. as i kept reviewing stuff (especially pre-made decks) Anki assumes all knowledge is in the same layer of understanding. it assumes that each flashcard is independent from the others, and that makes it difficult to actually progress while trying to learn a particular topic. Justin Skycak (the guy from Math Academy) ended up implementing spaced-repetition + prerrequisite graphs for math learning, and there i ended up seeing we could extend the concept more generally. one of the things Math Academy made me realize is that if we combine spaced-repetition (i.e. when we should review a card) with prerrequisite graphs (i.e. we keep unlocking new knowledge as we learn the prerrequisites), we can learn things more clearly and in a more structured way. that's where my "bet" goes. i want something like Anki, but with the option to create a graph of prerrequisites (e.g. you can't learn Y until you properly learn X). that's Armin. among other stuff, i also tried to fix some of the annoyances i had with Anki and make it as intuitive as possible to use. this is a non-exhaustive list of the things i worked on for this app: - UI polish of the interface. i tried to make it as intuitive as possible. - MCP server for letting agents read, edit and manage cards and decks. in particular, the MCP server is very useful for creating flashcards from any existing content you have. just point your agent to a resource (e.g. a pdf) and it will take its content and transform it into a deck with flashcards with its prerrequisites graph already created. - Anki-compatibility with caveats. the app supports bringing your existing Anki decks for most decks out there. however, some decks have custom cards that are not so easy to integrate seamlessly. there are plans to support custom cards in the future, but for now they are not implemented. - projects.title: Show HN: DeployAngel – A verdict in ~20 minutes if a deploy broke production
projects.author: jkowens
projects.summary: Hey there, I'm looking for feedback on a release verification tool I'm building. https://www.deployangel.com I decided to build this after an issue popped up with a recent Rails upgrade. We upgraded a Rails app to 8.1 and picked up a new default that changes the order after_commit callbacks run. Our upload code started telling the virus scanner about files before they were saved to S3, and the scanner just quietly dropped them. No exceptions were raised and uploads sat in "processing" for days. We should have had alarms in place, we know that now but I wondered if there could be some type monitoring that would just have noticed the change. I did some checking and the callback route went from roughly 27 requests an hour to zero when we deployed. That seems like a fairly easy change in behavior to automatically raise an alarm. So after a few weekends working with Claude I have a new tool. A small agent sends one aggregated payload per minute. Then the server compares each release with the last one it cleared. It looks at things like error rates, latency per route, traffic that collapses, and missing job runs. The server then returns a verdict if the release cleared or not. Currently I have agents for Rails, Django, FastAPI, and ASP.NET Core. It will work best for teams that deploy often and the app gets steady traffic. It's not meant to replace error monitoring tools like Sentry, but to work alongside them. Here's a recent release of its own: https://app.deployangel.com/share/KAaurrfRHcw43ZrjkWst2DLY?r... The agents are MIT-licensed. It's completely free right now, with a free tier planned. https://github.com/DeployAngel I'm looking for a few teams to run it on a real app for a couple of weeks. I'd love to hear if it surfaces issues that other monitoring and alarms miss. Of course I'm hoping it proves to be useful, but if not, that's good information too.

projects.title: 我做了一个不太一样的记账 App：它把个人财务变成了一场自己的「金融市场」
projects.author: lidinghui
projects.summary: 有时候，我觉得自己的钱挺神秘的。 明明工资按时到账，也没买什么特别贵的东西，但每个月总有那么几天，打开银行 App ，看着余额陷入沉思： 钱呢？ 我试着回忆这个月买过什么，脑子里只有几杯咖啡、几顿外卖和一些当时觉得很需要的东西。 单笔看起来都没什么问题，合起来就不太对劲了。 ![图片 2]( https://i.imgur.com/gnoLd1I.png) 我们每天都在记录这些变化，只不过大多数记账 App 最后给我们的，还是一张张账单和几个统计数字。 所以，我决定试着做点不一样的东西。 于是我开始想：如果能像看股票行情一样，看看自己的钱每天都发生了什么变化，会不会有意思得多？ 最开始只是一个想法：既然股票有行情，为什么自己的账户不能也有？ 于是，我开始把个人财务和金融市场的一些概念结合起来。 这就是 PFEx 的由来。 它本质上是一个记账 App ，不过有点不一样。 在 PFEx 里，每个账户都有自己的 K 线，可以观察余额走势、成交量和变化趋势。多个账户汇集起来，又会形成一条整体资产曲线。 收入、支出和账户间转账会被分别处理，资金流向也能通过桑基图直观呈现。除此之外，还有周期预算、专项计划、账户表现、龙虎榜和 AI 生成的财务研报。 如果不想自己翻数据，也可以直接和对话 Agent 聊天。查账、分析资金变化，甚至让它协助记录交易。当然，涉及账务修改时，仍然需要经过你的确认。 我甚至给自己的钱安排了一个研究部。 当然，我并不是想把生活变成一场股票交易，也不希望以后买杯奶茶都要先做一份投资分析。 真正有意思的，是看清自己的钱发生了什么变化，以及这些变化背后的习惯、欲望和选择。 毕竟，研究市场是为了理解别人的公司，研究自己的钱，大概是为了少一些月底看余额时的困惑。 如果你也觉得这个想法有点意思，欢迎试试，也欢迎告诉我你的看法。 官网： https://greyglow.cn/pfex/ Google Play： https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=pfex.greyglow.cn

projects.summary: 身边有朋友在处理 ChatGPT 订阅异常或者核对账户标识时，习惯直接打开 `chatgpt.com/api/auth/session` 把整个页面返回的 JSON 复制出去。 看过这个接口返回结构的应该都知道，最底部直接明文带着当前会话的 `accessToken`（JWT 格式）。只要在有效期内，拿到这个字段就等同于拿到了完整的登录态，可以绕过密码和 2FA 直接调接口或操作账户。 实际上用来区分账户归属的只是 `account.id` 字段（UUID 格式的 Account ID，本身不包含鉴权凭据）。为了避免手动复制 JSON 时不小心把底部的 `accessToken` 一起粘出去，我写了个简单的 Tampermonkey 油猴脚本，只在本地浏览器同源请求并提取 `account.id`。 ### 1. 临时用：控制台单行命令 如果只是偶尔查一次，不想装脚本，登录 `chatgpt.com` 后按 F12 在 Console 跑这一行就行： ~~~javascript fetch('/api/auth/session').then(r=>r.json()).then(s=>console.log('Account ID:', s?.account?.id || '未找到')) ~~~ ### 2. 常驻用：Tampermonkey 油猴脚本 如果平时需要频繁核对多账号或者排查订阅状态，可以直接用仓库里的 `tools/get-account-id.user.js`。 脚本逻辑很简单（总共 50 多行纯原生 JS，无外部依赖）： - 仅在 `chatgpt.com` 域名下注册油猴菜单项 `查询 Account ID（本地）` - 点击后同源读取 `/api/auth/session` 并解析 `account.id` - 弹窗仅展示脱敏后的 Account ID 供手动复制，不会读取或上传任何 Cookie 与 Token 另外在 `tools/check_connection.py` 里顺手放了个零依赖的 Python 小脚本，用来在终端快速测试相关公开页面的 HTTP 状态码、响应耗时与超时排查。 ### 3. 附带的 Codex 与订阅排查文档 最近 OpenAI 调整了 Plus、Pro 各档位的额度策略，加上不少人在终端用 Codex CLI（Sign in with ChatGPT 模式 vs API Key 模式）时经常遇到额度扣减异常或者已扣款仍显示 Free 的问题，我把 2026 最新的套餐对比、Codex 额度计算规则、银行卡拒付（AVS/卡段风控）排查整理在了同一个仓库里。 - GitHub 仓库： https://github.com/zhaozhao010/chatgpt-pluspro-tutorial - 脚本工具目录： https://github.com/zhaozhao010/chatgpt-pluspro-tutorial/tree/main/tools 代码和文档都很简单，主要图个安全省事。如果对大家有用欢迎点个 Star，文档里有出入的地方也欢迎提 Issue 补充。

projects.title: 我用 10 天，把 Super-agent 架构做成了一个 7×24 小时在线的产品
projects.author: nifengfei
projects.summary: 10 月 31 日，DeepSeek Harness 团队发表了《Super-agent 设计探索：迈向更自主的 Agent 系统》，读完以后我就做了个决定，要将它实现落地。10 天过去了，今晚我让刚上线的 Fable5.2 测完最后一个用例后，就正式上线了。 这是一个真正的 7*24 小时持久在线的 Super-agent，存算分离，云端 Loop 与重状态的环境解耦，水平可扩展，基本实现了文中说的架构和功能。同时是一个 SaaS 产品。 ### 1.为什么第一眼就决定要将它实现落地？ 因为我自己就是文中的「人肉 Router」，harness 和模型能力的提升使得我们不必再困于具体繁琐的工作，而是转向了更多任务的分配和决策，目标的验收。 回顾我的工作日常，基本上是同时开五六个项目，平均每个项目开 3-5 个 session，终端也从传统的 terminal 换成了支持无限拓展和布局的新型终端，一般还会辅助 Cursor 再开两 2 个 session，用来偶尔瞄几眼代码。大概是下面这样子，隐藏掉了项目的细节： ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/12D7WII5.png) 新终端效率很高，我偶尔看看 session 细节，和模型要我做的决定，更多是要在一个窗口启动服务器，另外一个窗口派任务，再来一个跑测试，还有一个询问项目细节，再来一个上网调研资料...然后模型没额度了，换个桌面版 agent，使用一下 Browser use，还有各个渠道来的信息。 我同时驱动很多 session 并行工作，我有任务目标，有一致的上下文，我在电脑桌前坐很久，我也希望换个沙发，躺下来用语音发命令。 Super-agent 这套架构看了一遍，基本觉得落地没问题，不是因为“工程问题很简单”，而是因为在我们只有痛苦和抱怨的时候，它已经将答案递到了我们面前，我觉得这绝对算**探索未至之境**。 我相信作者也是在经历了上述种种痛苦以后，再加上一个很小的产品试验，也就是「公共群聊中产品问题，到开发，到 pull request 提交」的一条链路，以小见大，加之计算机和行业知识的积累，才有了这份架构设计。这个设计基本就是量身定做的，同时将本地 Coding Agent 组合，然后搬到线上是我一直的想法。 ### 2.先从架构学习入手 文章认为 Super-Agent(简写 SA)具备下面四个特征： - **连续**：文中说的「连续」是围绕 Agent 在说的，它应该出现在它需要工作的所有地方。因为人是通过不同渠道和工具获取工作信息的，需要将 Agent 的上下文拉到同一个层次，而不是手动去维护这些。接入各个信息渠道，并共享上下文是关键。 - **高效**：信息和任务是并发来的，所以工作也应该并行执行，一个独立的任务不应该等待。这需要独立的，互不干扰的工作环境。 - **主动**：无需用户参与，持续观察环境并主动推进。这种是由于事件驱动的，触发 SA 的相应。其实还有一种 schedule 触发，按照时间规划来执行一些任务，时间间隔短一些，也可以有非常主动、聪明积极的感觉，并不是简单的定时任务。 - **持久**：也就是一些自我修复的机制。这样持续在线的 SA，一直有人帮忙清理异常，才能持续高效工作。 ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/BKEFFGAM.png) 围绕着这四大特征，设计了 5 个系统，这里重点讲一下「Router 层的双层架构」，并对它进行扩展设计，其他的就不赘述了。 #### 1. Router 层是整个系统的中心 其实它就是 SA，对外承担了交互的职责，统一和人对接，同时接入各个渠道，如 IM，Github，Slack，WeChat，Gmail 等等，对内统一管理下面的 Agent Worker，将他们的上下文统一在一个平面上。 再回顾下我之前的工作状态，其实是用它来替代了我这个「人肉 Router」，作为我的助理向我汇报工作，是我们个人管理项目成为可能。 ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/R5cQ39P2.png) 从 Router 这个角度看，有点像年初的 OpenClaw 小龙虾，但是差距还是非常大，后面有时间可以对比几个类似的产品。 #### 2. 面向「任务/Task」的设计 文中详细描述了 Router 层所要处理的跨任务信息和决策，重点讲解了事件驱动的消息路由过程和设计。 但让人要面对的对象还是 Session，可以理解为是一个上下文统一、独立完整的工作流程，因为 LLM 的加入会更加智能。但要想实现复杂项目管理的目标，还涉及到工作流程的调度，项目人员的管理和分配，资源的配备等等。 所以在产品落地的过程中，引入了「Task」的概念，让人真正在项目中只需要参与「任务」的管理，同时保留 session 等细节可供执行回溯。同时它也让 SA 在水平方向上的拆分成为可能，因为文中也指出 SA 在事件路由过程中并不会成为瓶颈，没有必要再水平方向上扩展。下面右边侧边栏是「任务」列表界面，点击后可进入「任务视图」： ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/GqMsP77O.png) #### 3. 异步 ReAct 架构 从整体上看，Router 和 Worker 这套架构就是一套异步的 ReAct 方案。Router 派发消息给 Worker，并不用等待，立马可以处理下一条，多条消息同时到达也可以同时处理，增加吞吐量。当 Worker 结束任务后上报处理结果，Router 返回给用户。ReAct 就体现在更加复杂的异步调度上，由于「Task」的引入，不同 session 可以并行，可以 if-else，也可以 wait-continue 等等。 ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/L5gLchf7.png) 作为异步任务的执行，我觉得大家对执行时间的包容度还是很大的。它做它的，我去干别的，等它做完收报告。 其实没有太明白 DeepSeek Harness 为什么引入异步 ReAct，从架构上就可以了。 ### 3. 产品落地过程 10 天的落地过程主要分 3 步骤，前期主要使用 Opus5.5 和 Fable5.1，但在后面设计 Router 的过程中它们降智非常严重，经常一个问题也说不到重点，那几天基本都吵架到深夜...好在过了两天 Fable5.2 发布，开始有了进展。 #### 1.统一设备、agent 的接入，作为 worker 资源提供 开始做的第一步，我并没有去实现 Router 相关的部分，而是先将所有的本地 Coding Agent 搬到线上，统一管理。这个是很早就有的想法，是非常独立的一部分，本身就能非常大的提高产品体检和效率： - 可以随时、随地接入，而不用守在电脑旁边 - 独立的 Agent 资源隔离，角色、任务、工具、技能等等可以定制化和可视化。制作出非常多独立轻量的 Bot。这个也非常重要，反观很多桌面类产品将很多东西大杂烩，产品设计就是堆功能，用户体验就是摸不着头脑。 - 组合各家 Coding Agent，使用最强 Harness 和 LLM 所以第一步就是物理上拉通所有的电脑等设备，逻辑上拉通所有的本地 agent，可以作为底层的 woker 作为调用。所以先发布了 Crewbot，一个开源的 daemon，在每台设备上安装一下（后期可能集成进桌面版，用户感觉会更好），具体介绍和仓库在： ``` https://github.com/nifengxiaofei/crewbot-connector ```` 安装后的效果就是: ``` (base) test1@MacBook-Air daemon % crewbot status crewbot 0.2.7 (protocol v2) Daemon status running (pid 65637, up 1d 23h) server https://super-agent.team — reconnecting for 7m agents 0 process(es) running account linked Device hostname MacBook-Air.local os darwin (arm64) Agents Claude Code 2.1.321 ✓ ready Codex 0.166.0 ✓ ready Grok 1.0.77 ✓ ready ``` ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/tk6Tvb33.png) #### 2.每个 bot 都是独立的，可在线派任务 为了最大兼容之前的工作模式，接入后每个 Bot 都是一个独立的执行个体。和它们对话、派任务就和在本地 CLI 使用没有区别，所有「数据」、「订阅」或者「API」使用的都是本地设备上的。 >这些 CLI Agent，如 Claude code，Codex，Deepseek Harness 等都是大量的工程实践，配备专业的模型才是最佳实践。 我最喜欢的一个功能就是自定义每个 bot，给它配备不同的 skill，帮我执行任务，利用开放的专业技能，大大扩展我的个人能力。我也将 skills 市场集成了进来，搜索和安装一键合成，我可以轻松配备一个 Bot 军团为我干活，评估效果。 >现在市面上 agent 落地方式最多基本都是 agent+skill，bot 已经帮你轻松组织好了。 ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/6gsN02Y9.png) 而且至此，这些产品的功能都是「**免费**」给大家使用，只需要线上注册一个账号就行了。 #### 3.接入 Router 上面的这些功能将你本地的 Agent 团队带到了云端，worker 工作环境还是留在本地。但你还是一个大管家，只是交互体验和隔离性更好了。要真正实现「项目管理」，还需要加入智能助手 Router。 任何的项目或者任务管理都需要： - 1、创建任务和目标，查看分配任务，查看任务目标，验收任务 - 2、给任务和目标配备资源，这里就是干活的 bot，配备不同工具、技能和资源 ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/sfW9guN3.png) 现在可以从 web 端，手机 web 端接入发消息。Router 根据消息将任务派发给 Bot，bot 干完活回来报告给你。事件驱动和投机执行都能轻松实现。 #### 4.后续的功能规划 形成一个更加完整，功能强大的产品还需要后续的一些规划： - 1、给 Router 配备更多的信息接入渠道 - 2、同步上架移动端 app 和桌面版本，桌面版本自动集成 daemon - 3、Router 应对更加复杂的任务调度等等 在产品设计和使用的过程中，也强烈的感受到了文章说的，哪怕是配备了个人助理，每个人的使用方式，项目任务，工具以及对 AI 的理解都不一样，所以 Super-Agent 也是高度定制化的，在使用的过程中自己调整和定制。 ### 4.最后的 非常感觉大家能够看到这里，如果对这个产品很感兴趣，可以访问下面的地址，注册一个账户就可以将你的设备和 Agent 搬到线上，完全免费。 ``` https://super-agent.team/ ``` 如果想体验 Super-Agent Router 或者有任何问题，可以加下面 wx，加入种子用户群 ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/N2ui0RF7.jpeg)

projects.title: 【自荐】Tipitaka.ai：基于巴利三藏原典的 AI 学习与查证工具
projects.author: surmon-china
projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一个我正在开发的网站：Tipitaka.ai。 它以巴利三藏及相关文献为基础，结合 AI 问答、原典阅读和巴利辞典，帮助读者学习佛法、查找并核对经典出处。 通用 AI 在回答佛教问题时，有时会混淆不同传统，或者给出难以核实的经文出处。我希望通过整理结构化的巴利文献，让回答尽可能附上可点击的出处，读者可以打开原文自行核对。 网站目前提供： AI 问答：用自然语言提问，并通过引用链接查看相关文献。 三藏经阁：阅读巴利三藏原典及相关文献。 巴利辞典：查询巴利词条、多语言释义和发音，并浏览相关百科条目。 例如，可以试着提问：佛陀的第一场说法发生在哪里？ 项目免费使用，无广告、无付费订阅，接受自愿捐赠。AI 回答仍可能出错，欢迎结合引用的原典核对，也欢迎体验和反馈。

projects.summary: 这是一次自荐。rightcommit 是一个可视化的 AI 智能体工作流编排工具：在画布上设计工作流，或用自然语言描述需求，由 Project Manager 助手自动生成可编辑的工作流草稿。每个步骤可分配给 Claude Code、Codex 或 Pi，并加入测试、智能体审查和人工审批等质量门禁。不仅用于写代码，也适用于研究、文档分析和报告生成。工作流还能发布为兼容 A2A 的智能体。Rust 编写，Apache-2.0，自托管。 亮点 本人为项目作者（Lorenzo Toscano / ltoscano），此次为自荐。 可视化画布 + Project Manager 助手：用自然语言描述要自动化的任务，Project Manager 助手生成可编辑的工作流草稿，在画布上检查、调整后即可运行。也可以从预置工作流开始，例如 Spec Kit 的规范 → 计划 → 任务 → 实现。 多智能体协作：同一工作流中，不同步骤可分别交给 Claude Code、Codex 或 Pi。 质量门禁与人工审批：检查任务是否关闭、运行服务端测试、智能体审查、人工审批通过后才提交；文件在测试后若有变化会重新验证。支持交互、辅助和无人值守模式，可暂停等待人工决策后继续。 连接与集成：GitHub、Azure DevOps、ServiceNow，以及通过 Atlassian CLI 接入的 Jira、Confluence 和 Bitbucket；支持 MCP，工作流可发布为兼容 A2A 的智能体。 FinOps：按智能体、模型和执行查看成本与 Token 用量。 自托管：默认绑定 localhost，使用自己的密钥；可用 Docker Compose 或 macOS 上的 Homebrew 安装。仓库提供简体中文 README（READMEzh-CN.md）。

projects.title: Show HN: I have trained a model to predict my blood sugar
projects.author: 0xdeadf1sh
projects.summary: I have trained a custom 31,253 parameter encoder-only transformer on a pregenerated synthetic CGM dataset and fitted it to my own personal data using LoRA. It is competitive among other published models. I used 115 days of CGM data, of which 80 was used for training the adapter and 35 for testing. The model began with a pretraining stage where it consumed ~19,200 CGM-years worth of synthetic data, consisting of 1 million simulated type 1 diabetics at 7 days each. The simulator is designed to aid in counterfactual reasoning, but I don't yet have a benchmark to test these capabilities downstream. Simply using these models on my phone gives me the impression that they do indeed react appropriately when forced to consider future insulin & carbs. In addition to time series input, two additional inputs are provided: insulin (U) and carbs (G, GI) as action curves where U = units of insulin, G = carbs in grams, GI = glycemic index. U is exact, while (G, GI) is my best estimate. The model is trained to output BG in Kovatchev risk-space using {DILATE,MSE} and pinball loss combined with learned Kendall-Gal weights. The figures above show models trained using DILATE. It can predict 2 hours into the future, infill missing traces, and do backcasts (predictions into the past). The model is also trained to predict time-of-day given past blood sugar, in contrast to other models that consume time-of-day as input feature. This capability emerges in >=48h context windows (i.e. 48 hours of past CGM trace). Natively the model has a variable context window size of 3.5 - 7.0 days. The model is still worse than me when it comes to predicting hypoglycemia in the next ~30 minutes.

projects.title: Show HN: Thousand Suns, a nuclear war sandbox
projects.author: gxd
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm the author of Thousand Suns (1KS). This has been my full-time project for the past six months and is now available as freeware for Windows, Linux and macOS (experimental) on itch.io. It started as a game but slowly turned into a serious simulation as I educated myself on nuclear war. I'm a stay-at-home dad, previously a Big Tech software engineer, and not a nuclear war expert. But I spent an enormous amount of time learning about the subject from original and derived sources, such as the well-known site NUKEMAP. It goes beyond existing free projects by simulating full conflicts on top of single detonations. The conflicts are “all out” and meant to be a demonstration of the power of present-day arsenals rather than a depiction of nuclear war escalation. This was made with Godot/C# and I spent a good amount of time hand-optimizing the code... Not because it was needed, but because it was fun! I'm not using any external libraries with the exception of Godot itself. It was all custom-made and the nuclear calculations were derived from the amazing 1977 book "The Effects of Nuclear Weapons" by Glasstone and Dolan. I decided to make it free because I think it's important to raise visibility on what is, perhaps, the most dangerous threat to our survival. Without minimizing the many other risks we face, it is the one way civilization as we know it could end tonight. Feel free to ask any questions and I hope 1KS is useful for you!

projects.title: 做微信小游戏踩的坑--详细版
projects.author: DearFox
projects.summary: 想起什么说什么,基本是要做微信小游戏就需要了解的. iOS 上微信小游戏能用的内存有上限：整个微信进程内存和显存共用大约 1G 到 1.4G(具体看手机内存)，超过就会被系统杀掉；另外 5 秒内收到两次内存警告，微信也会直接销毁小游戏。 别以为你游戏资源包只有几百 MB 就没事。PNG 、JPG 只是文件小，进显存要解开成原始像素，每个像素 4 字节，小游戏占用只看分辨率：一张 2048×2048 的图不管文件多小，都占 16MB ，开了 mipmap 还要再多约 1/3 。要是你的游戏资源几百 M,基本玩着玩着就必崩溃. 解决办法是用 ASTC 压缩纹理：显卡能直接读压缩后的数据，4×4 块的显存是原来的 1/4 ，6×6 约 1/9 ，代价是画质略有损失(我自己测试看不出分别)；再配合用完及时卸载资源，就能把峰值压下来。拿我游戏来说，战斗峰值从约 1G 降到了 200MB. ASTC 压缩还有个问题,可能会把某个类型的图片变成洋红色,真机才会出现,所以一定要测试好. 用户手机发热可以在小游戏网页后台给你的游戏接入高性能模式,能大幅度降低发热问题,其他也有能优化的,腾讯这点好在每个文档里面都有一键复制,直接给你的 AI 看,完美接入. 网页后台显示 100 用户就可以开启流量主,手机看要 1000,这里以网页后台为主. 任何游戏,一定要弄新手教程,用户进来几秒不知道干啥,绝对就退了,想象你自己玩小游戏,有那么耐心吗? 游戏版本审核的时候,只要你的资源需要额外下载,审核界面一定要选择联网,而不是单机,这里不是看你游戏的类型,只要有云上资源,就要联网,不然审核员用不能联网的环境审核失败,会直接打回. 加载云上资源的时候,游戏一定要显示具体的大小或者文件进度,我买的腾讯 cdn,按理来说网络肯定可以,但是几次遇到下不动的情况,如果你的游戏没有详细说明,用户可能会以为卡死,直接就退了. 第一次版本审核成功,后台会建议你用他们的代码加固插件,用的时候代码混淆选中等就行,高选项会直接让主包大于 4M. 接入好友排行功能,要在后台开启这个功能,不然游戏不保报错,但是也不显示内容,会让用户疑惑. 每个游戏可以开启新游种子,基本会给量让你开启流量主,一定要把版本弄好再开启,不像我,新手引导都没有就开启了,浪费了... 就说这么多吧,哎,不做游戏看别的游戏都是垃圾,一做才发现真的难啊,总是有一些问题出现,更难受的是辛辛苦苦做完,没有流量 现在小游戏不花钱推,基本都没入尘烟了 我的游戏是割草类游戏,就是各种技能搭配,纯爽游,感兴趣的朋友微信搜:站桩修仙

projects.title: Show HN: Pots – Open-source Grok Bot alternative, used by 6 startups for a month
projects.author: Crokily
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm Crokily. Pots is an AI coworker that lives in the chat your team already uses: Slack, Discord, Telegram, or any channel with a Chat SDK adapter. It is MIT-licensed and runs on a machine you give it, with the model you choose. To be honest, the first time I used Grok Bot, its design really impressed me. Unlike OpenClaw before it, it was not just Claude Code connected to a chat app. It truly cared about how it works with people. It felt like a living AI assistant, and working with it was painless. That is the idea I kept learning from the whole time I built Pots: it is not an agent hooked up to a chat channel. It should be a coworker that feels alive and is comfortable to work with. But Grok Bot is only Grok's bot. Which model you get depends on your X subscription, your data and your machine are all in the cloud, and most of all, it is a standalone app, and most of its features serve that app. Pots is a bit different. In Sydney I have talked with quite a few founders. Grok Bot is good, and it helps them a lot with their personal tasks. But when I asked who had actually put Grok Bot into their company's work to make their startup team faster, nobody had. So I think Pots is in a different place from Grok Bot, and from most open-source Grok Bot alternatives: it grew out of what real startup teams need. Before I open-sourced it, 6 small startups I met at startup events had been using it with me for over a month. Pots is built first for the channels startup teams already work in, not for an app of its own, so most of what it does serves the places where you actually work. The teams use Pots as a middle layer: a CEO talks ideas through with the team in chat, Pots listens, and then it builds a prototype that both sides can check. They use Pots for competitor research: because Pots runs inside their channels, it knows their product well. Not only the GitHub repo, but the team's daily discussions and what the team cares about. Pots has been listening quietly the whole time, so it knows the product with no setup at all. It also works well with each channel: it talks to people with the channel's own controls, like Slack and Discord buttons and cards, and when it hands over something complex, it deploys a page with its built-in server so everyone sees it in a better form. So Pots is different from Grok Bot and from most open-source alternatives. It came out of what real startup teams need. Its channel features start from what each company's work needs, and it can join your real work setup with no setup and still do well, instead of being one more app that nobody uses and that is hard to start with. And it ran in real business for a while before I cleaned it up and open-sourced it. The difference from Grok Bot is also exactly why I made Pots an open-source Grok Bot alternative. I have OpenAI and Claude subscriptions with plenty of quota, and my own servers, so I don't want an X subscription to limit me. I want to use whatever model I want and do whatever I want. I can even switch to an open model, and none of my data goes into anyone's pocket. Try it (Node 24+, macOS, Linux or Windows): the easiest way is to ask your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to read docs/for-agents.md in the repo and set up Pots for you. Or by hand: npm install -g pi-durable-bot, then pots init. I'd love feedback, especially on how it decides when to act.

projects.summary: AGASTHY： 一个开源的桌面应用，把整台开发机连成一张图：本机的 Git 仓库（包括未提交的改动）、各语言运行时（哪个 python / node 真正生效，哪些被遮蔽了）、Homebrew / npm / pip 等装的包、AI 工具和 MCP 服务器，全部关联到一张知识图谱里，每条信息都注明来源。 几个主要功能： 删除前先看影响：比如卸载 openssl@3，会列出哪些项目会坏、哪些会退回到另一个已安装的版本，并给出恢复方法。 AI 编程 Agent 面板：同时开着 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Hermes 时，看每个会话占多少内存、启动了哪些 MCP 服务器和 dev server，以及 Agent 退出后还在跑、还占着端口的进程。 Token 用量：从各 Agent 自己的本地日志读取（只读计数，不读对话内容），按天、项目和模型统计，并按 API 公开价格估算成本。 安全清理：只清理被 Git 忽略、可以重新生成的目录（nodemodules、target 等），先移进可恢复的隔离区；任何操作都先 dry run，确认后才执行。 做它是因为同时跑多个编程 Agent 以后，机器上多了很多看不见的东西：没人关的 dev server、每个几百 MB 的 Agent 进程、重复的依赖和缓存。我的 Mac 上同时开着 6 个 Claude Code 会话，一共占了 1.7 GB 内存。现有工具要么只管磁盘，要么只看进程，没有一个能说清这些东西之间的关系，以及删掉某个东西会影响什么。 它也能给 Agent 用：自带只读的命令行工具和 MCP 服务器（9 个工具），Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenClaw、Hermes 可以直接问「哪些项目有未提交的改动」「3000 端口被谁占了」「这周 Agent 花了多少 token」。 本地优先：不需要账号，没有遥测，数据只存在本机的一个 SQLite 文件里。Rust + Tauri，Apache-2.0 协议。主要支持 macOS（Apple 芯片），Windows 和 Linux 是预览版。README 顶部有一分钟的演示视频。 我是作者。

projects.title: Show HN: Belay – formal verification for SQLite migrations and queries in Lean 4
projects.author: neprotivo
projects.summary: Hi, I'm Tzanko and I'm the author of Belay. Belay is a Lean 4 library for doing formal verification of SQLite queries and migrations. It implements a semantic model of a subset of SQLite, validated by differential tests that compare the output against native SQLite. With Belay I wanted to see how difficult it is to use formal verification for everyday development tasks. It turns out it can be made not much harder than writing an integration test: you state the claim, the agent writes the proof, and Lean's kernel checks it, so the only thing you have to read is the claim (longer write-up on the motivation and agent workflow: https://vihren.dev/blog/20261112-belay/ ). While a migration is being written, your agent can run #sql_check, which searches small databases for counterexamples to a claim, and is as easy to run as a linter. Once the migration is settled, the agent writes a proof of the claims you need, for example that the migration preserves the results of existing queries and succeeds on valid data. Currently Belay supports a subset of SQLite 3.51.0, cross-checked against native SQLite on 5,768 differential test cases, most of which come from SQLite's own test suite. Unsupported SQL is rejected with a reason and never approximated. Not every rule of the model has had a human audit yet. The model covers single-connection operational semantics only: it says nothing about query plans, locks, concurrency or crash behavior. I think this approach can make formal verification as routine as testing, though two things stand in the way. The first is coverage: the model has to cover the full semantics of SQLite and all of its recent versions, and the same work has to be done for other engines such as PostgreSQL and ClickHouse. The second is proof cost: the proofs of common claims are still long for the agent to write, and they have to become short. I'm looking for design partners who want this for their workloads on SQLite or other open-source databases, because a real workload is the best guide to what to cover first. The models that come out of that work become part of Belay as open source. Reach out at contact@vihren.dev. If you know a tricky SQLite edge case where the model might diverge from native SQLite, or a gnarly migration bug you've hit in production, I'd love to test it and hear your thoughts.

projects.summary: Project URL Category Python Project Title clx: switch AI coding accounts without restarting Project Description clx is a Linux launcher for Anthropic's coding CLI. It starts each session on whichever of your own Pro/Max accounts has the most usage left. At its 5-hour or weekly limit, clx moves the running session to your next account without a restart. Highlights Unlike switchers that pick an account only at launch, clx also moves a session that is already running. The conversation, background tasks and subagents carry on; only the login used by the next request changes. At launch it compares every window the server reports (5-hour, weekly and per-model) and picks the account with the most room. One standard-library Python file, a bash hook and an installer. SECURITY.md lists every file it writes and the one request it makes, and --uninstall removes it. It is for accounts that are all yours. The README has a "Use it within Anthropic's terms" section; sharing an account is forbidden. I'm the author of clx. Example Code bash curl -fsSL | tar xz ./clx/install.sh cm-login work you@work.example # log in a second account, named work clx --status # every account, its usage, and which one clx would pick clx # start on the account with the most room Screenshots or Demo Videos

projects.summary: 自荐一个我们刚在 GitHub 开源的项目 Oryh（Apache-2.0，FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + PostgreSQL + React 管理台）： GitHub 2 分钟实机演示（YouTube）： 线上体验： （国内）/ （海外） 为什么做 Oryh？ 市面上很多 AI ERP/CRM 是在传统表单界面旁边加了一个聊天框，结果 Agent 反而要花大量上下文去适配既有的界面字段和写死的状态机。Oryh 选择了相反的分工：软件只负责把账记老实、守住权限与数据边界，业务判断与推进全部交给 AI Agent。 三个核心设计： 1. Agent 就是业务前端：没有日常业务录入页面，员工直接用自己惯用的 Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw、Hermes 或任意 MCP 客户端，用自然语言完成报工时、贴发票报销、拟报价单、核对采购三单匹配、预留库存并过账发货；React Console 仅保留给管理员做团队配置、权限管控和审计回看。 2. 业务规则是带版本的自然语言，而不是 if/else：审批流、折扣红线、数据校验规范以纯文本形式存储在版本化、带生效日期的 businessrules 表中，流程位置由只追加的 approvalrecords 与 todos 实时推导——调整审批路线只需对管理员 Agent 说一句话，无需改代码或重新发布。 3. 零 SDK 的 SKILL.md + HTTP（并原生内置 OAuth 2.1 POST /mcp）：员工本地 Agent 通过浏览器 Device Flow（oryh-connect）授权一次，即可自动拉取与其 RBAC 角色严格匹配的 Markdown 技能包和 OpenAPI 契约；服务端通过 PostgreSQL Row-Level Security（RLS）、不可篡改明细账本及账期锁定兜底，确保 Agent 无论怎么理解上下文都无法越权写坏账。 单租户完整功能开箱自托管（docker compose up -d --build，支持可选执行 scripts/seedsample.py 一键加载虚构公司样例数据进行体验）。欢迎大家体验和指正！

projects.title: 历时 15 天, 经过 108 次版本迭代, 我给 OpenWrt 做了一款 本地 DNS 服务器: updns
projects.author: investor
projects.summary: 最初我的需求只是网络走哪里，DNS 就跟着走哪里，这符合网络流量最短路径. 因此 基于域名匹配的 DNS 路由、 `NFT set`联动要被作为核心实现. 现在历时 15 天, 经过 108 次版本迭代, 我做成了它. 与`dnsmasq`不同的是，`updns` 提供了更灵活的 DNS 路由、 `NFT set`联动，除此之外它还支持 `DoT`、`DoH` 且拥有强大的 `主动预取`、 `广告拦截` 和 `DNS 审计` 能力。 与`smartdns`不同的是，`updns` 在 OpenWrt 上提供了更简洁清晰的 Luci 交互、更严谨的 `NFT set`联动, 除此之外, `updns` 尊重本地网络, 不做 IP 端点 速度探测, 因为当下 运营商 提供的 DNS 在国内大部分网络已经路径最优, `updns` 做的是 获取本地解析文件, 自动将运营商 DNS 纳入可自行选择的上游之一. 这里说的有点多, 因为此前我也是 `smartdns` 用户, `smartdns` 做的也不错, 但是现在我放弃了它. 来展示, 哈哈哈: ```txt OpenWrt → ~ # ping www.baidu.com PING www.baidu.com (2409:8c00:6c21:11eb:0:ff:b0bf:59ca): 56 data bytes 64 bytes from 2409:8c00:6c21:11eb:0:ff:b0bf:59ca: seq=0 ttl=55 time=5.535 ms 64 bytes from 2409:8c00:6c21:11eb:0:ff:b0bf:59ca: seq=1 ttl=55 time=5.462 ms 64 bytes from 2409:8c00:6c21:11eb:0:ff:b0bf:59ca: seq=2 ttl=55 time=5.397 ms 64 bytes from 2409:8c00:6c21:11eb:0:ff:b0bf:59ca: seq=3 ttl=55 time=5.507 ms 64 bytes from 2409:8c00:6c21:11eb:0:ff:b0bf:59ca: seq=4 ttl=55 time=5.366 ms 64 bytes from 2409:8c00:6c21:11eb:0:ff:b0bf:59ca: seq=5 ttl=55 time=5.126 ms 64 bytes from 2409:8c00:6c21:11eb:0:ff:b0bf:59ca: seq=6 ttl=55 time=5.305 ms ^C --- www.baidu.com ping statistics --- 7 packets transmitted, 7 packets received, 0% packet loss round-trip min/avg/max = 5.126/5.385/5.535 ms ``` 下面是 DNS 审计功能, 在 OpenWrt 你可以通过 updns 命令, 清晰获取指定域名 匹配的规则、选择的上游、加入了哪个 NFT Set 、解析结果是怎样: ```text root@OpenWrt:~# updns google.com ╭─ updns ──────────────────────────────────────────╮ │ │ DOMAIN │ ────────────────────────────────────────────── │ Domain : google.com. │ Query Type : A / AAAA │ Query Path : Cache Hit │ │ DNS RESULT │ ────────────────────────────────────────────── │ Matched Rule : US Access │ Upstream : A=Google-DoH / AAAA=Google-DoH │ Action : IPv4 + IPv6 │ Response : NOERROR │ │ NFT SETS │ ────────────────────────────────────────────── │ IPv4 : inet/fw4/us4 │ ✓ Contains resolved IPv4 │ IPv6 : inet/fw4/us6 │ ✓ Contains resolved IPv6 │ │ ANSWERS │ ────────────────────────────────────────────── │ • 142.251.219.142 │ • 2607:f8b0:4005:818::200e │ ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────╯ ``` 广告拦截 功能当然也有了, 你要做的只是把需要屏蔽的站点域名放入一个文件, 让 updns 来使用它, 下面我通过日志功能来展示它: ```txt Sat Nov 14 17:16:51 2026 daemon.info updns[18922]: QUERY [CLI] ad.xiaomi.com. A → AD Blocked → ZERO-IP RULE → NOERROR Sat Nov 14 17:16:51 2026 daemon.info updns[18922]: QUERY [CLI] ad.xiaomi.com. AAAA → AD Blocked → ZERO-IP RULE → NOERROR ``` 如上, 我定义了一个名为 AD Blocked 的规则, 它匹配指定域名列表文件, ad.xiaomi.com 在这个文件中; 由于该规则指定了 ZERO-IP 返回, 于是 ad.xiaomi.com 的 DNS 解析会被拦截, 并以 ZERO-IP 返回, 最终客户端拿到的解析结果是: 0.0.0.0 / ::. 除了 ZERO-IP , updns 也支持 NXDOMAIN 拦截. 下面是, 如何安装, 对于 OpenWrt 25.12, 我提供了官方软件源, 通过下面命令可以便利安装: ```sh # 下载软件源签名公钥 wget -O /tmp/updns-public.pem https://downloads.garinasset.com/updns/openwrt/signing.pem # 核对公钥 SHA-256 sha256sum /tmp/updns-public.pem # 安装公钥 cp /tmp/updns-public.pem /etc/apk/keys/updns.pem # 配置软件源 ARCH="$(apk --print-arch)" echo "https://downloads.garinasset.com/updns/openwrt/25.12/${ARCH}/packages.adb" >> /etc/apk/repositories.d/customfeeds.list # 更新软件源并安装软件包 apk update apk add updns luci-app-updns luci-i18n-updns-zh-cn ``` 对于历史版本, 可以查看 官方 指南 手动编译安装. 以上, 除介绍以外, 还有一些实用且强大的功能, 包括缓存 主动预取, 因为迫切想让大家使用体验, 我就不过多展开了. 对了, updns 我给它的官方取名是 道岔 DNS, 想象像铁路道岔一样, updns 可以让你对 DNS 解析拥有更灵活的控制能力。 开放源代码: - [GitHub 软件仓库]( https://github.com/garinasset/updns) - [使用指南]( https://github.com/garinasset/updns/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md)

projects.author: integrity_softw
projects.summary: This is an in web browser address bar URL authenticity verification tool using only a special redirection system attached to the subdomains of trustedurl.org For example, to check the authenticity of and visit the authenticated site, add .trustedurl.org after the Top-Level Domain. >getmonero.org.trustedurl.org Entered into the address bar, this resolves to >getmonero.org You can also just type in the domain name without the TLD >getmonero.trustedurl.org Which similarily resolves to >https://getmonero.org This of course also works with the protocol >https://getmonero.org.trustedurl.org >https://getmonero.trustedurl.org Now say an attacker were to make a phishing site getphished.org, and you were uncertain if it were authentic. In this case, just apply the same postfix to the suspect domain >getphished.org.trustedurl.org Which resolves to a connection error page, because it isn't in the authentic URL whitelist. So far only a few cryptocurrency exchanges simpleswap.io, trocador.app, bisq and wallets bitcoin.org, electrum.org, getmonero.org have been added to the whitelist, along with torproject.org, i2p.net, freenet.org, devuan.org, tails.net SimpleSwap cryptocurrency exchange >simpleswap.trustedurl.org >simpleswap.io.trustedurl.org TAILS OS >tails.trustedurl.org >tails.net.trustedurl.org Monero wallet >getmonero.org.trustedurl.org >getmonero.trustedurl.org There are many fake websites and URLs that closely resemble the real sites, and going on the wrong site can easily lead to getting scammed of money and downloading malware. Using this tool prevents this by providing an extra layer of security if one hasn't memorized the exact fully qualified domain.

projects.summary: 这是什么 一套完全从零自研的本地 AI 全栈：推理引擎、插件总线、爬虫、知识库、Web UI、训练管线，全部手写，AGPL-3.0 开源。没有 llama.cpp、没有 PyTorch（训练对账用完即弃，产物零外部运行时）、没有任何第三方依赖——每一层都是可审计的纯 C / 纯 stdlib 代码。 我们做了什么 纯 C 推理引擎：三值量化核（1.58-bit）+ SIMD 快路径，权重自定义 2-bit 打包格式（.aimw） 权重转换器：微软 BitNet 官方 gguf → .aimw，一条命令完成 插件总线：约 100 行 C 实现，caps.json 注册表 → 拉起 Python 插件 → JSON 信封通信；模型不感知插件，确定性路由决定调用 多引擎爬虫：bing/百度/360 并行 + Edge 渲染级联（JS 重站点自动升级渲染），robots.txt 遵守 + 质量五信号闸（残文长度/壳密度/句子结构/信息密度/菜单味），fail-closed 知识库：FTS5 全文索引 + 查重闸，中文维基 dump 自建（CC-BY-SA 署名） 本地 Web UI：纯 stdlib，127.0.0.1:8600，对话直答 / 知识库引答 / 联网搜索→爬取→入库→引答全链路 训练管线：无自动微分训练栈（手写反向传播，29 参数 selftest 对账相对误差 5.7e-7）、十科课程生成器、语料构建器 117 章研究日志：SIMD 逐位对账、投机解码熔核、负面结果档案全部公开 实测结果 | 项目 | 数字 | |---|---| | 三值核 SIMD 快路径 | 85.53 tok/s（从 2.08 优化 41 倍） | | BitNet b1.58-2B-4T 推理 | 3.20 tok/s（双工人；串行 1.99） | | 权重体积 | 0.87 GB（.aimw 格式） | | C/NumPy 逐位对账 | 全绿（差一个 bit 不许提交） | | HF 贪心解码对账 | 前 9 token 逐位一致 | 测试配置（就是一台 2018 年的老笔记本） | 部件 | 规格 | |---|---| | CPU | Intel Core i7-7500U @ 2.70GHz（2 核 4 线程，低压 U） | | 内存 | 8GB DDR4-2133 单通道 | | GPU | GeForce 940MX（太弱，弃用——整套栈纯 CPU） | | 系统 | Windows | 优势 1. 断供免疫：全栈自研零第三方依赖，断网可运行、自主可服务，关键路径全部 vendor 进自家仓库 2. 全层可审计：引擎到 UI 每一层一个下午能读完，bug 可定位 3. 硬件门槛极低：2018 年双核低压 U 就能跑 2B 模型，多核/AVX-512/大内存机器欢迎帮忙测上限（我们没条件验证） 4. 训练资产全公开：课程生成器、语料构建器、正负面结果一起发——负面结果档案可能是仓库里最值钱的部分 5. 诚实文化：自研分词器未完成全量验证就明说，第三方权重配套微软官方分词器 诚实边界 2B 是这套硬件的舒适上限 自研 152M 模型还在训练（免费云容器），权重未发布，管线与证据全公开 Windows 优先（渲染级联用 Edge），Linux 编译通过、级联需装 Chromium 7 分钟演示视频在 README 顶部（实机录屏：对话 / 知识库引答 / 联网全链）。AGPL-3.0，研究文档 CC-BY-NC，微软权重 MIT 归属声明见 NOTICE.md。

projects.author: _fat_santa
projects.summary: Hey everyone, I've been very interested in software factories lately but every time I've read about them, I see folks talking alot about high level concepts and the idea of a software factory but never actually walk you through how to set one up. Or if they do walk you through how to set one up, it's always overly complicated and requires a ton of up-front investment to get things running. In response to this I built rowbly, a CLI that tries to make it as easy as possible to understand and setup a software factory. Rowbly at it's core works like a kanban board and each column can contain an optional prompt that instructs an agent what to do when a story is within this column. Once you have some stories on your board you run a supervisor skill that monitors the board for changes and spawns agents to work on stories within each column. The default configuration ships with 5 columns: backlog, refinement, development, review and done. Once a story is moved into refinement, the supervisor automatically dispatches an agent to refine the story based on the instructions in that column. When refinement is finished the ticket is automatically pushed into the development column when another agent is spawned, then into review and finally into done when the PR is merged. While this is a default configuration, things can get much more exotic based on how things are setup. Each column prompt will define where the story goes after it's finished in that column, so you could wire up a very sophisticated setup, review loops, security scans, testing, etc. From a data perspective I tried to keep things as simple as possible, all data is stored in plain markdown and json files in the folder where you initialize rowbly. If you're interested you can run it directly with npx using: `npx rowbly` or install globally with `npm install -g rowbly`. When you run it for the first time, it will walk you through adding stages, prompts and companion skills but all of this can be modified to your liking. Github Repo: https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/

projects.title: Casvisor： JumpServer 之外的开源堡垒机， Apache-2.0，一个 Go 二进制装下 SSH / RDP / VNC / Telnet
projects.author: Casbin
projects.summary: 团队里管着几十台服务器，最后都会走到同一个问题：谁在什么时候连了哪台机器，做了什么？ 常见的做法是共享账号、把 SSH 密码发在群里，或者大家一起用同一个跳板机账号。真出了事，登录日志里只有一行 IP ，查不到人；有人把密码带走，也无从知道。 堡垒机就是解决这个的。但看了一圈开源的选项： - JumpServer：国内事实标准，但 RDP 代理、数据库的原生客户端代理（ Magnus ）、远程应用这些放在企业版里； - Teleport：AGPL ，社区版二进制对企业规模和收入有限制； - Next Terminal：2.0 起服务端闭源，免费版限 100 个资产； - Boundary：仓库已经归档； - Warpgate：Apache-2.0 ，Rust ，单二进制，是目前最接近「完全开源」的对手。 我们想要的是：功能完整、一个二进制就能跑、能接自己的 SSO 。找不到，就自己写了 Casvisor 。 ### 连接 **SSH**：网页里是 xterm.js 终端，旁边带一个文件面板，走 SFTP 上传下载。 **RDP**：自己写的纯 Go 客户端 [gordp]( https://github.com/casvisor/gordp)，支持 NLA 、GFX 图形管道（ ClearCodec 和 RemoteFX Progressive ，和 Windows 自带客户端一样的画质路径）、高 DPI 下的清晰字体、远程光标、剪贴板、跟随窗口改大小、通过重定向的磁盘传文件。Windows Server 、Windows 10/11 都连过，FreeRDP 那一类主机也能连。 **VNC**：noVNC ，VNC 的认证由后端做，浏览器拿不到 VNC 密码。 **Telnet**：给交换机、老设备用，自动填资产里存的账号。 **SSH 网关**：`ssh -p 2222 web-01@casvisor.example.com`，scp 、sftp 、rsync 、Xshell 、VS Code Remote 都能用，用公钥登录，权限和网页里是同一套。 **网域网关**：机器在另一个机房、或者在公司 NAT 后面，Casvisor 直连不到时，用一个 SSH 跳板机中转；连跳板机都没有的网络，可以在里面随便找台机器跑 `casvisor agent`，它主动连出来，不监听端口。 密码和私钥都是加密存库的，SSH 主机密钥和 RDP 证书首次连接时记下来，之后变了就拒绝连接。用户全程看不到服务器的密码。 ### 控制 权限按 用户 / 用户组 × 资产 / 资产标签 来配，动作有连接、复制、粘贴、上传、下载、端口转发，可以限来源 IP 段和有效期。用的是 Casbin 。 命令规则：正则匹配，命中就拦（不把回车发给目标机器，改发 Ctrl+C ）或只告警。网页终端和 SSH 网关都生效。 撤销立即生效：改权限、删权限、权限到期，已经连着的会话会被断开。 ### 审计 四种协议的会话都录像，回放就在浏览器里，用的是实时连接那套代码。SSH 和 Telnet 的录像还能下载成 asciicast 。 在线会话可以实时旁观，也可以直接断掉。 SSH/Telnet 的命令记录是从一个虚拟屏幕里读的，Tab 补全、上箭头调历史、中文、行内编辑都能记准； vi 、top 这种全屏程序里的回车和输密码不记。 文件传输和所有 API 改动都在操作日志里。 ### 运维 顺带做了补丁管理：SSH 资产可以扫描待装的系统更新，一键安装、重启。Windows 走 Windows Update 的 COM 接口，Linux 支持 apt / dnf / yum 。 ### 部署 ```shell docker run -d --name casvisor -p 19000:19000 -p 2222:2222 \ -v casvisor-db:/db -v casvisor-recordings:/recordings casbin/casvisor ``` 默认 SQLite + 自带账号，管理员口令打印在日志里，第一次登录后改掉。要 SSO 、MFA 、LDAP 、社交登录，接 Casdoor 就行； Casdoor 的用户组直接能用在权限里。 ### 老实说的部分 - 没有数据库代理（ MySQL / PostgreSQL 的网页连接和 SQL 审计）和 K8s ，JumpServer 社区版这两个都有； - 一个资产只有一组系统账号，没有多账号、自动改密、访问申请工单； - 没有资产树和批量导入，资产多了管理起来比较笨； - 录像只能存在本机目录，还不能放 S3 / OSS ； - 本地账号模式没有 MFA ，要 MFA 得接 Casdoor ； - 命令审计靠读虚拟屏幕，不是把键盘输入全录下来，全屏程序里的操作看不到。 在线演示： https://demo.casvisor.com （有一个假的 SSH 和一个假的 VNC 可以连） 文档： https://casvisor.org 代码： https://github.com/casvisor/casvisor Apache-2.0 ，欢迎 issue 和 PR 。

projects.title: Show HN: Bot-bottle – secure runtime, DLP and remote control for local agents
projects.author: didericis
projects.summary: Hey! About 6 months ago, I started looking for a tool to safely run coding agents on my (security sensitive) developer machine. Specifically, I wanted a tool that: - I could use regardless of the model or harness running underneath - I could build simple, composable, plaintext security policies for - Provided strong vm level isolation - Hid credentials from agents - Scanned and monitored everything going in and out of agent workspace - Allowed me to use the same mobile flow I had gotten used to with claude code, but with arbitrary harnesses I couldn't find a tool that met all of these, so I started bot-bottle. It's evolved into what I'm hoping will be the best security conscious, local first coding agent orchestrator out there. Here's how it works: Each agent runs in its own microVM (Firecracker on Linux, Apple's container on macOS, Docker as a weaker fallback), with whichever harness you want. Claude Code, Codex and pi are built in, and custom agent providers are supported (still being documented/tested). What an agent can reach is defined in a "bottle", which is just a short markdown file listing hosts, repos and which secret goes to which host. Bottles are enforced by a gateway outside the agent VM, which adds the real credentials to requests on the way out, so the agent only sees placeholders. Bottles stack, so you can keep small ones around (npm read only, one repo, one API, etc) and combine them per task. Repos can ship their own bottles, which only run after you trust their exact contents. Outgoing requests and git pushes are scanned for secrets, and everything is logged locally (you can stream it to your own endpoint as NDJSON or OCSF). Anything a bottle doesn't allow comes to you for approval, in the terminal or on your phone through an optional paired console. It's in alpha (the console especially), so UI polish is still in progress. Install: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/diderisoft/bot-bottle/main/install.sh | sh Docs: https://bot-bottle.com/docs Would love feedback, especially on the threat model and on whether bottles are the right abstraction.

projects.title: Show HN: Ramble – Message your agent directly from your Apple Watch
projects.author: Jpoliachik
projects.summary: I made Ramble because I wanted to get off my phone but still be able to capture thoughts, reminders, action items - whatever. Some of my best thoughts happen when I'm playing with my kids or on a run - and this lets me stay in the moment, fire off a quick message on my watch and not get pulled into the screen waiting for AI to respond - never get sucked into 'lets solve this now' mindset. Ramble is designed for Apple Watch & offline first - to capture voice quickly and queue up messages to send when it can. The slim relay backend uses cloud transcription (Grok Whisper currently), then holds the message in an inbox for your agent to pickup and process, then gets purged from the backend after acknowledgement. No accounts, no signups. It uses Apple's App Attest for endpoint security. It works great with current gen personal agents like Muse, GrokBot, etc. (GrokBot supports incoming webhooks so its instant. Muse doesn't, so it polls every couple minutes (without waking the agent)) The linking process is surprisingly easy. Would love to hear what you think!

projects.title: Show HN: Vaultbase – a self-hosted back end in a single binary
projects.author: khalidsheet
projects.summary: One binary to run and you have a full backend at your fingertips: a database with a REST API, sign-in, realtime, files, server-side hooks and jobs, on SQLite or Postgres. It's MIT licensed. You can try the demo at https://demo.vaultbase.sh (the login is filled in, and it resets every hour). I built it to ship fast. I always tend to write the same logic for any new project, whether it's a side project or a small to medium project for a client. I wanted something my friends and I could work with fast, try new things with, and that's easy to use. Then it became something I really wanted to work on and make as complete as I can for any type of backend. As of writing this post it has 80 releases since May this year and is backed by more than 2,800 tests. I also run security reviews with Claude and fix what they find. It hasn't had an outside audit yet. It was built with the help of Claude, from the codebase to the documentation and fact-checking it against the code. Claude helped speed up the pace, find bugs, and write tests. Vaultbase is pre-1.0, so expect some bugs and issues here and there. I'm working hard to fix each and every one of them. Thank you for taking the time to read this. I'd really appreciate any feedback, even if you didn't like Vaultbase. The demo is yours to try, and it's two commands to run locally.

projects.title: Show HN: Beam – Pairing machines with passkeys; replace SSH&VPN's with Tailcat
projects.author: hermannbjorgvin
projects.summary: A concept I wanted to share that is built on TailScale's Tailcat https://tailscale.com/tailcat The inspiration is that I was thinking of ways to allow my users to be able to pool their machines easily without needing to set up SSH or a VPN. How can you lower the barrier to entry without compromising on security. The end result is you get a remote shell connection and a Tailcat tunnel that only requires your user to know how to use passkeys to verify their machines. Any machine can join the pool without having connected to the others at any point before which is also a strength. The primary weakness is that even though all the passkey assertion and encryption/decryption happens on the browser side you are still trusting a Cloudflare worker to store it. So I think this is more of a solution for things like Herdr, T3 code, etc etc where you want to connect machines in a pool. Each machine also has a small SQLite mail inbox for those purposes, you can queue messages that your machine will receive next time it is reachable. For a more in depth explanation I created this artifact with Fable 5.2 and Astra 6 to clean up the prose: https://claude.ai/artifact/NVHSV1FNmpPaPsqRakskVW

projects.title: [开源推荐] AgentFlow：Docker 一键私有化部署的 AI Agent 平台
projects.author: PHclaw

github.name: PHclaw/agentflow
github.description: 自托管 AI Agent 平台：拖拽式工作流 + 知识库 RAG + 23 个预置技能，默认 SQLite 单机可跑，一条 docker compose 私有化部署。Self-hosted, OpenAI-compatible.

projects.summary: 一个自托管的 AI Agent 平台：在浏览器里拖拽连几个节点、填几行提示词，就能把大模型、内部文档和常用工具拼成能干活儿的助手。默认两个容器加一个 SQLite 文件，不依赖 PostgreSQL 和 Redis，一条 docker compose 命令跑起来，数据存在自己硬盘上。适合数据不能出内网、又没有专职运维的中小团队；代码量适中，也适合拿来读源码。 亮点 1. 部署成本低到能塞进一台小机器 两个容器（后端 + nginx）加一个 ./data/agentflow.db 就是全部，docker compose up -d --build 完成部署，备份等于打包 data/ 目录。同类自托管方案起步通常要 PostgreSQL + Redis + worker，四五个容器。 2. 产物是真文件，不是一段文字 生成的 xlsx / png / pdf 作为附件回传，图片类直接内联渲染在对话里，不用先下载再看。这一点和多数「只回文本」的方案差别明显。 3. 换模型不用重启，已入库的向量也不会失效 任意 OpenAI 兼容端点（含本地 Ollama），界面里保存即生效。embedding 端点独立配置——换对话模型不影响向量库，不用重新入库。很多同类产品把这两个绑在一起，换模型等于重建知识库。 4. 技能就是目录 加一个带 SKILL.md 的文件夹就多一个能力，仓库自带 26 个（Excel 表格、PPT 生成、PDF 处理、学术检索、会议纪要、统计分析…），扩展不需要改任何代码。 5. 工作流引擎自研，节点状态实时回传 没有用 LangGraph——需求就六类节点（触发器 / LLM / 知识库 / 工具 / 条件 / 回复），引框架反而多一层调试成本。自研的好处是画布上的节点会逐个点亮，用户能看见跑到哪一步。 适合初学者学什么 后端 FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2.0 async，前端 React 18 + ReactFlow，代码量适中，读源码能学到几条完整链路： SSE 流式输出：为什么不用 EventSource（不能带 Authorization 头），改用 fetch + ReadableStream 后怎么按帧解析 向量检索落地：文档解析 → 分块 → 调 embedding 端点 → 存 chromadb → 检索注入上下文，一整条 RAG 链路 把 LLM 应用做成可部署产品：Alembic 迁移与 createall 的顺序坑、JWT 鉴权、限流、Docker 多阶段构建 原生打包：用 Capacitor 把同一个 Web 前端打成安卓 App，下载逻辑怎么从 换成 Filesystem + Share 已知限制 没有异步任务队列（长任务会占住请求），权限只有「用户 / 管理员」两档，pgvector 路径未做端到端验证。定位是小团队自用，不适合高并发场景。

projects.summary: 我做了一个工具：3 分钟就能把 GPT 生成的图片转成可编辑的 PPT，艺术字也能保留。 之前做汇报 PPT 时，我发现 AI 生成的幻灯片非常好看，是我这种理科生远远做不出来的。问题是它改不了。AI 只要出现一点小幻觉，或者文案有点 AI 味，就只能重新生成、反复抽卡，结果还不一定比第一次好，让人很恼火😡。我也试过不少 skill，烧了一堆 token，速度和效果都不理想，所以决定自己做一个转换工具。 传送门：https://editableppt.com/ 在这之前，我试过 gpt-image-2.5 的透明背景、Seedream5、Canva、Codia，还去闲鱼找过代做。代做明码标价，一页 1～2 元，偏贵。而且我发现他们用的也是 Canva 或 Codia，做得还没有我自己精细。 转了一圈，我发现现在的做法大致分两派： - **基于生图模型**：先标注并抠出可拆分的元素，再用 OCR 提取文字，最后重新生成背景。优点是可控；缺点是成本高、速度慢，背景补全全靠运气，文字一多就补不好。它也很难处理多层结构，一般只能拆两层，层数一多就更慢，成本也直线上升。 - **Canva 路线**：要自己部署分割模型、inpainting 模型、OpenCV 和 OCR 深度模型，普通人很难负担。而且 Canva 识别中文效果差，容易乱码，大段文本还会丢失格式。 于是我想把两者结合起来：在现有 GPT 模型和一些开源模型的基础上做微调，再拿大量案例让 Claude 反复测试效果。最后真的做成了，目前在我测试的产品里，我做的是最精细的，该转的转，不该转的不转，特别对中文进行了优化，段落换行和中文识别。 我自己的问题解决了，相信别人也会遇到同样的困扰，所以做了这个网站，希望能帮到同样被做 PPT 困扰的人。 我给大家准备了免费试用积分，不够用可以私聊我。遇到问题、发现 bug 或者想要新功能，都可以直接回复或发邮件给我。 ![预览图](https://i.imgur.com/rQXNnHZ.jpeg)

projects.title: Show HN: Darkroomfinder.org – A Directory of Photography Darkrooms
projects.author: stokesj84
projects.summary: I built darkroomfinder.org, a directory of photography darkrooms, as a React single page app (SPA), because I wanted to understand how SPAs work and I wanted to scale to hundreds or thousands of cities without managing routes and pages for each of them. The site currently lists over 350 darkrooms across over 50 countries. However in deciding to build a SPA I failed to realize the downsides of SPAs for SEO. As an SPA darkroomfinder.org only has one route, i.e. darkroomfinder.org. Therefore GoogleBot only indexes the root domain and if someone searches for "Darkrooms" the site might surface in Google Search, but if a user searches "San Francisco Darkrooms" Google Search is much less likely to return darkroomfinder.org as nothing indicates the site has information about San Francisco. Solving this SEO problem while maintaining the simplicity of the SPA turned out to be a challenge but I think I have arrived at a solution that checks most of the desired boxes at the cost of being tied more closely to Cloudflare's infrastructure. Cloudflare, the DNS and CDN for darkroomfinder.org, has a serverless primitive, Cloudflare Workers. These Cloudflare Workers are distributed at the edge, have KV caches, and can intercept specific paths. So my solution to having both an SPA and indexable city routes is to have Cloudflare Workers cache the city data and intercept city routes directed at darkroomfinder.org returning an HTML page with the city data and the full React SPA which boots over the HTML page. So technically it's one SPA served to many routes. GoogleBot in traversing one of these city routes, like darkroomfinder.org/san-francisco, will index the HTML page while humans using browsers receive the same HTML which the React SPA boots over. Part of the project that remains unsolved is data collection and validation. Darkroom discovery is automated by agents running daily scans for unlisted darkrooms. But a human still has to validate that the discovered darkrooms exist and try to determine what capabilities they have such as B&W or color developing etc. I am currently working on an automated reachability and vitality checker to determine if the darkrooms already in the directory are still active, since photography darkrooms sometimes cease operations long before taking down their websites or social feeds. darkroomfinder.org

projects.author: zkitkevin
projects.summary: 最近在尝试做英文游戏攻略站，刚把一个围绕 Suzy Says 的小站上线： https://suzysays.co/ Suzy Says 是 MOONBIT 做的一款恐怖游戏。我这边做的是非官方攻略站，主要整理官方下载入口、新手说明和结局相关资料。 这次用了 AI 配合网站引擎，从查搜索结果、确定页面内容，到写页面、预览和发布，完整走了一遍。 过程中有两件事让我印象比较深。 一开始想做成首页直接玩的游戏站，但核实后发现，作者官方提供的是 Windows 下载版。网上虽然有些页面写着“在线玩 Suzy Says”，继续查它实际加载的游戏地址，却发现其中一个嵌入的是另一款游戏。所以最后改成了攻略和官方下载指引，没有硬塞一个播放器进去。 另一个是结局资料。不同视频和攻略对 Good、True、Bad 的叫法不完全一致，有些触发条件也互相矛盾。现在的处理方式是把开发者明确确认的信息和视频作者的说法分开，附上来源，不把没验证过的步骤写成确定的通关教程。 目前主要做了三个页面： - 首页：官方下载入口、操作和版本区别。 - 新手指南：尽量不剧透，给第一次玩的人看。 - 结局参考：整理名称差异、Full 版要求和相关视频，剧透提示可以展开。 站点部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上，页面通过引擎生成，支持预览后再发布。中间还遇到一个引擎检查默认要求首页必须绑定游戏的问题，后来补了攻略首页模式才顺利上线。 想请大家帮忙看看几个地方： 1. 第一眼能不能看懂这是一个什么站？ 2. 页面导航和文章入口是否好找？ 3. 如果你是搜这个游戏进来的，还希望看到什么内容？ 英文表达、页面体验或者资料准确性有问题，也欢迎直接指出来
