projects.title: Local Dictation
projects.summary: Local Dictation turns your voice into text on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. The speech model is built into the app, so it works in airplane mode and nothing you say is uploaded. On iPhone and iPad a keyboard dictates into any app; on a Mac you hold a key and talk. More than 90 languages, clipboards for each topic, optional on-device translation on iPhone and iPad. No account, no ads, no tracking. Typing on the keyboard is free; dictation needs Pro.

projects.title: Netrix
projects.summary: Netrix brings SSH, Telnet, Serial and SFTP into a local-first Windows desktop app. Manage hosts, split terminals, transfer files, reuse snippets and view network maps. An encrypted workspace and credential vault keep saved data local. Free, MIT-licensed beta.

projects.title: RPGadget
projects.summary: RPGadget is a desktop toolkit for Game Masters on Windows. Bring in the rulebook you own for any RPG. RPGadget sorts your whole rulebook and makes it searchable. Nothing added, nothing removed. You are in full control. Build your world, its people and places, plan your campaign, and run the night from one desk. Your players join from their phones in any browser, at the table or across the country. Your books stay on your own PC. Try the free demo before you buy.

projects.title: Diskly
projects.summary: Diskly lives in your menu bar and warns you before your Mac runs out of space, naming exactly what's safe to clear. Open it to see where every gigabyte went, System Data included, explained in plain language. Delete with Undo.

projects.title: Pikori
projects.summary: A Mac menu bar app that shows what's left of your Claude Code and Codex 5-hour and weekly limits, with the exact reset times. It also keeps your recent copies and shows CPU, memory and battery. A pixel character gets tired as you run low.

projects.title: Dexibi
projects.summary: Meet Dexibi - an AI operator for your Windows desktop. Instead of switching between apps, menus, and prompts, tell Dexibi what you want to accomplish. It can interpret your instructions, use supported desktop tools, interact with applications, and help carry out multi-step workflows through voice. From everyday computer tasks to developer workflows, Dexibi is being built to turn natural instructions into real actions. Your voice. Your computer. The work gets done.

projects.title: USAddressGen
projects.summary: USAddressGen is a free random US address generator for testing — no signup required. Every address comes as an atomic city + state + ZIP triple, with 50 state-level filter pages, NANP reserved (555-01XX) phone numbers, and example.com reserved email addresses, so your test data never points at real people. Export to clipboard, save as a file, or download CSV/JSON. Built for form QA, database seeding, design demos, and localization testing — plus generators for HK, UK, JP and CA addresses.

projects.title: Sirio
projects.summary: Sirio is a native desktop app that runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and Oh-My-Pi side by side, in terminals and chats for every git worktree, with a code editor, language servers and your pull requests beside them. Open source under the MIT licence, written in Rust on gpui.

projects.title: Pulso
projects.summary: Pulso is a Mac monitor for developers. Memory, swap and free disk in the menu bar; music, a Pomodoro timer and your Claude Code sessions in the notch; and a bottom bar that can replace the Dock. One-time payment, no account, under 1% CPU.

projects.title: Eyebrow
projects.summary: Eyebrow turns the notch into a live strip for music, volume, downloads, timers, meetings and Claude Code, and opens into a shelf, clipboard history and 18 widgets. Free on the Mac App Store; Pro is a one-time $4.99 with a 3-day trial.

projects.title: DarkCrate
projects.summary: DarkCrate is a desktop app for BlackBox contributors. It needs a BlackBox account and uploads only to BlackBox. It isn't a general stock footage tool. Editor: log-to-Rec.709 color for Sony, Canon, DJI and iPhone footage, looks, scopes, trim, crop, horizon leveling and stabilization. Metadata: built-in AI runs on your own computer and drafts each clip's title, description and keywords. Then it checks the clip and uploads it. No API keys, no subscription. Free for 10 clips, then $79 once.

projects.title: SandboxSim
projects.summary: SandboxSim starts an isolated macOS virtual machine from the macOS already on your Mac. No restore image to download, about 0.5 GB per new machine, Setup Assistant in about 20 seconds. Shared folders, clipboard and Touch ID.

projects.title: Trakisilo
projects.summary: Trakisilo combines your task board, clipboard manager, and time tracker into one desktop app that never touches the cloud. No account, no subscription, no network calls — your data stays on your machine. 2.0 ships a redesigned glass interface, a visual diagram canvas, math rendering, a smarter journal, and in-app viewers for Excel workbooks and Outlook mail attachments — openxlsx,xls,csv,eml, andmsg files right inside Trakisilo, no external app needed.

projects.title: Mesa
projects.summary: Mesa is a calm to-do list for iPhone and Mac. Three lists and nothing else: Today for what's due now, Upcoming for the week ahead, and Inbox for everything without a date. Reminders, repeats, place reminders, Siri and Shortcuts, and a one-tap import from Apple Reminders. No account, no setup, no tracking. Free to use, with Mesa Plus for iCloud sync, Apple Calendar, widgets and the Mac menu bar.

projects.title: Show HN: Lantern – desktop app that maps your repo and reviews AI-written PRs
projects.author: gitsad

projects.title: Kharchivo
projects.summary: Take control of your money without paying monthly subscription fees. Kharchivo makes personal expense tracking effortless with 1-tap iPhone & Android shortcuts, Excel/CSV bank statement imports, automatic duplicate detection, real-time spending analytics, recurring bill reminders, and calendar-based expense management. Everything you need to understand and manage your money, completely free. No subscriptions. No locked features.

projects.title: Confetti Magic
projects.summary: Celebrate any win with one shortcut: confetti, fireworks, snow or emoji rain across your whole Windows desktop, over every app and every monitor. Shipped a feature, closed a deal, finished a sprint, or made it to Friday? Press Alt+Shift+D. Share your screen on Teams, Zoom or Google Meet and everyone on the call sees it. Pause before you present; pick your colours and emoji sets. No account, no tracking. Free 7-day trial, then $4.99 once. A free Chrome extension does the same in your browser.

projects.title: Wherever
projects.summary: Wherever brings every file name on your disk into one live search. You can find a file by typing part of its name, narrow the results with filters, search the words inside your documents, and open a search panel from any app with one shortcut.

projects.title: Freehand Control
projects.summary: Control your Android device completely hands-free using your front camera. Perfect for cooking, studying flashcards, or browsing when your hands are busy or messy. 100% private, offline processing with custom gesture shortcuts and a smooth air-pointer.

projects.title: Sheenshot
projects.summary: Capture, beautify, and find any screenshot by its text. Hide desktop clutter with one shortcut, get backgrounds from the screenshot’s own colors, and paste size-right shots into AI chats. For Mac. Free, no account, no cloud.

projects.title: CharaBuddy
projects.summary: CharaBuddy is an AI desktop pet app for Windows, macOS and Linux. Install an interactive animated companion that chats by text or voice and lets you customize its look.

projects.title: Zen Timer
projects.summary: Zen Timer is a calm Pomodoro and focus timer for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac, with a timer in the Mac menu bar. Every session you finish helps Orbilla, your focus companion, grow and rank up. It has the Garden, 12 languages and, with Zen Plus, Plan my day. No account. No ads. No tracking.

projects.title: PairOnce
projects.summary: PairOnce sends files and text between your phone and computer, browser to browser. No app, no account. Pair once with a code or QR. End-to-end encrypted, files up to 2 GB with resume, plus clipboard, scan to PDF and a command line for AI agents.

projects.title: Family Tree Design
projects.summary: Family Tree Design is a desktop app to map your family across generations. Build visual family trees, get AI BaZi analysis, hereditary risk alerts, blood type inheritance prediction, and smart name generation. All data stays local on your device — nothing is uploaded. Windows, macOS, and Linux, with a free trial.

projects.title: seshka
projects.summary: Claude Code sessions end. The dev servers, watchers and scripts they started don't. seshka shows them in your menu bar, grouped by session, with memory and ports. Kill them in one click. End idle sessions too, by hand or automatically. Free and open source.

projects.title: Show HN: Clview – a universal doc viewer for the terminal
projects.author: ferd
projects.summary: I hate leaving the terminal, so clv was born: it shows images, Markdown, PDFs, Word documents, spreadsheets, SVGs, and HTML right in your kitty-compatible terminal. Supports light/dark modes, search, copy to clipboard, follow links (ala Vimium), browsing directories/zips/tars, open your default app. I hope others find it useful. I'd appreciate your feedback! --- Short boring history: clv began as the `view` subcommand I proposed for pdfcraft's cli (PR #2920). I immediately realized I wanted to support other types of docs. Prior to clv I was using icat for images, tdf for PDFs, mdv or mdcat for Markdown, and didn't have a solution for most other doc types. So I imagined a "display anything" command, and here we are.

projects.summary: 一个开源的桌面应用，捕获电脑或指定应用播放的声音，实时识别并在屏幕上显示双语悬浮字幕，同时支持快捷键框选屏幕翻译文字。适用于看外语直播、生肉番剧、打游戏或开外语会议。 主要特点： 支持全部系统声音或单个应用：可以只听浏览器里的直播，不影响正在玩的游戏；字幕窗支持穿透点击、跨屏拖动，并可在录屏中隐藏。 支持完全本地离线运行：语音识别（Apple 原生识别、SenseVoice、Qwen3-ASR）和翻译（Index-Translate、Hy-MT2）均可下载模型在本机离线运行，也可选择云端或接入自己的 API。 边说边译：不用等对方整句说完，前半句先给出大意，说完再补全整句翻译，看直播不卡顿。 场景与专名对照表：针对常看的番剧、主播或游戏建立词表，既能统一译名，也会把语音识别听错的近音原文一并改对。 免 OCR 截屏翻译：遇到没配音的游戏对话框、视频看板或直播弹幕，按快捷键框选屏幕即可直接多模态翻译。 使用 Go + MyGo 构建，GPL-3.0 开源，提供 macOS 和 Windows 版本（Linux 版本即将推出）。

projects.title: [WeClipper] Windows 剪贴板助手更新到 v0.8.8：搜索、纯文本粘贴、Win+V
projects.author: xmagicer
projects.summary: 上次在 V 站发 WeClipper 还是 v0.4.5，来补个更新帖。 之前评论里有人说，没有搜索就不会换，也有人问能不能用 Win+V 唤出。现在这两个都有了 hh 还是个 Windows 剪贴板小工具，按快捷键唤出列表，选中后直接粘贴。免费，不用注册，剪贴板内容保存在本机。 官网：[https://weclipper.xmagicer.com/](https://weclipper.xmagicer.com/) 下载：[Windows 安装版](https://weclipper.xmagicer.com/#/download)（Windows 10 及以上） 相比[上一帖](https://www.v2ex.com/t/1112466)，主要多了这些： - **搜索和键盘操作。** 面板打开后按 Ctrl+F 搜索，↑↓ 选中、Enter 粘贴；当前列表前 9 条可以用 Ctrl+1～9 直接粘贴。不用搜索的时候，输入框就收起来。 - **纯文本粘贴。** 选中条目后按 Shift+Enter，或者从右键菜单里选。快捷键可以自己改。也修了从表格复制后，纯文本粘贴为空的问题。 - **固定面板。** 固定后粘贴一次不会关掉，可以接着选下一条。常用条目也可以固定在列表前面。 - **图文预览。** 同时带图片和文字的条目会显示“图片＋文字”，可以分别预览图片和原文。按住 Alt 临时预览，松开收起；按右方向键也能展开预览。 - **Win+V 唤出。** 设置里可以开启替代系统剪贴板，也可以继续用自己的快捷键。唤出、搜索和纯文本粘贴的按键都可以在设置里改。 界面也重新整理了一遍，分类和搜索放在同一行，固定、删除放进了右键菜单，列表清爽一点。 新版的样子： ![WeClipper 面板](https://weclipper.xmagicer.com/shots/zh/panel-light.png?v=1bb79ecbac62) ![图片和文字分别预览](https://weclipper.xmagicer.com/shots/zh/mixed-light.png?v=1bb79ecbac62) 之前用过的可以再试试，有什么用着不顺手的地方，欢迎留言。

projects.title: 做了一个 iOS 离线音乐播放器 离音： Wi-Fi 拖歌、APE/FLAC/DSD、10 段均衡器更新啦，发帖送一波永久 pro 送码
projects.author: andyiac
projects.summary: 一个纯本地音乐播放器（iPhone / iPad / Apple 芯片 Mac），无账号、无广告、不上传音频。1.7.3 共 19 处改动，补的是几件一直欠着的事：能播的格式少一块、桌面上没得用、从服务器拿歌得先存到「文件」。 格式：MP3 / M4A / MP4 / AAC / FLAC / ALAC / WAV / AIFF·AIF / CAF / MP1·MP2 / OGG·OGA / Opus / DSF·DFF / APE；APE 与 FLAC 内嵌 CUE 也认，旁边放 .lrc 就是逐行歌词。另有 10 段参数均衡器与 ReplayGain。 ![](https://i.imgur.com/bkiQd0O.png) ## 1.7.3 更新 1. APE 现在能直接播（Pro）。不是导入时先转一道 WAV，是边读边解码：后台线程按块取 PCM 进环形缓冲，均衡器和播放器照常取数据，全程没有中间文件。为什么不做缓存转码——APE 无损，一首五分钟解成 WAV 就是 50–100MB，一张专辑几百兆，首次播放还得等转完；实测解码速度是实时的 20–100 倍，余量足够，没必要拿磁盘换时间。代价是只做立体声：多声道的 APE（DVD-A 抓的那种）直接拒绝播放，不静默下混。 2. 整轨 + .cue 的专辑按曲目分开。APE 与 FLAC 内嵌的 CUE 也认，不用在文件旁边再放一份。 3. Mac 上原生运行。不另做一套 Mac 界面，同一份工程跑在 Apple 芯片的 Mac 上，曲库、播放器、Wi-Fi 传歌、导入全是 iPad 那一套；长页面可以按住鼠标拖动滚动，和系统里其它应用一致。取舍：需要 Apple 芯片的 Mac，Intel 机器不在范围内。 4. WebDAV 导入。浏览服务器目录，挑文件或整个文件夹，落到本地和「文件」导入走同一条管线——命名、去重、元数据、CUE 展开都一致，不会出现「服务器来的歌和本地的不一样」。服务器密码进钥匙串，不写明文配置。取舍：单向的「挑一次、落到本地」，不做双向同步，也不扫你服务器上的整个曲库。 5. 睡眠定时独立成页（Pro）：圆环选时长，1 分钟到 14 小时，结束前淡出；倒计时可以暂停，想多听两首按一下，不用重设。 6. iPad / Mac 键盘快捷键：空格播放暂停，⌘← ⌘→ 切歌，⇧⌘← ⇧⌘→ 快进快退，⌘R 切循环、⌘S 切随机；设置里新增一页列全。 7. 其余几处：音频或整个文件夹拖到文件夹页即导入；长按一首歌直接改标题、歌手、专辑、封面；歌单、收藏和自定义标题导出成带版本号的文件，换设备导回去；「存储」页拆开显示音频、封面、歌词、数据和缓存各占多少；关联文件夹保留目录结构，新文件不用手动重扫；文件在 App 外被改名或移动后，歌单按路径 → 文件名 → 标题与歌手三步找回；搜索更快，大小写和变音符号都不敏感；歌单页加了「最近播放」。 8. 修了几处老毛病。最要紧的是换 Apple 账号后 Pro 不再消失：只有商店明确告知「已撤销」才锁回免费，账号切换、离线、商店没回应都保留上一次判定——宁可晚锁一个退款的，也不误锁一个付过钱的。另外修了：中日韩标签的曲名不再变问号；同时带新旧标题标签的歌显示正确标题；横屏在歌词处下滑能收起播放器；系统关掉实时活动时，锁屏歌词页会说明原因并给出开关入口。 免费下载；Pro 一次性买断，不订阅。DSD 与 APE 播放、保存自己的 EQ 调音、播放倍速、睡眠定时、全部主题与播放器样式、备用图标与自定义封面、三行锁屏歌词在 Pro 里，其余都能免费用。 ## 送 10 个码 ``` 8EKFE6TETNPAFN6TKH TPH66L6FMHRTM773XF 4L4W4XL3F7XWTTWETA MAPF4Y3TR3FP4K7FPL 86ET78FWRRXARMNXKP MKYRXKJMHWLTKX7JPF HHRHENAW7834HTRR7M AMEHKARATPTWXA8XNJ WMPER7TRL7XN6AKPT8 L37NTNEFJFK7EWEPR7 ``` 有问题大家可以进群反馈 ![](https://i.imgur.com/vcwUVqA.png)

projects.title: Show HN: A local-first AI agent for the desktop, no Electron, any LLM endpoint
projects.author: scronkfinkle
projects.summary: Hey folks. Most all the apps I see for agent harnesses are typescript based, and involve either electron or some form of IPC to function as a desktop app. In the age of LLM's, I thought it would be cool to build out a prototype of what a modern desktop application would like for this, without using any web code, since I can have agents pretty aggressively work on the cross-platform compatibility on my behalf. After about a week, I ended up with a harness that feels pretty good! Feel free to try it from the releases or you can install directly via: ``` cargo install byob ````

projects.title: Nextpage
projects.summary: Cross-platform desktop app (Electron) for split-pane search + AI chat. Click a result to add it as a source; you stay on the results page. AI chat answers are a small window: a few links, a confident summary, and no next page. Search still has one. Nextpage keeps Google, Bing, or Yandex open beside DeepSeek, ChatGPT, or Perplexity so you can page through live results and feed the chat the URLs, titles, and snippets the model never opened. The model does not pick the sources. You do.

projects.title: Mic Drop for Google Meet

Mute with your shortcut, AirPods, or Stream Deck, or any other way you like, and everyone on the call sees you’re muted. No more “muted by system” warnings. Everything just magically works. Free, for Mac.

projects.title: Treeporter
projects.summary: Treeporter makes uploading files to GitHub simple, fast and accessible from any device. Features: - Drag-and-drop uploads - Multiple file uploads - Real-time progress tracking - ZIP file support - Progressive Web App (PWA) - Native macOS desktop application No terminal or Git commands required. Just connect your GitHub account and upload your files. Treeporter V2.1.0 is now available!

projects.title: MacMemo
projects.summary: Replace Wispr Flow, Raycast and Grammarly with one app. Launch apps, find files, clipboard history, snap windows, control your devices, dictate and ask AI, all from one shortcut.

projects.title: Seamless Paste
projects.summary: Seamless Paste is a Chrome extension that keeps your formatting intact when copying and pasting text across platforms. Convert Markdown into clean, structured content with bold text, italics, headings, lists, links and spacing. Format for LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Instagram, emails and documents. Includes live preview, keyboard shortcuts and rich-text mode. Everything is processed locally in your browser. No account required. Free to use.

projects.title: ASO Gauge
projects.summary: ASO Gauge searches the App Store and Google Play three times a day, in 175 countries, and shows where your app ranks for each keyword: real searches, not estimates. When your listing changes, it tells you on day 28 whether the change helped. A desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux, free for 7 days, then paid once. To check one rank without installing anything, there's a free rank checker on the site.

projects.title: Clipio
projects.summary: Clipio is a free, open-source clipboard and file collection app for macOS. Browse and search copied text, images, links and colors in a lightweight Liquid Glass shelf. Gather files from different folders, then drag them where you need them. Everything stays on your Mac.

projects.title: ProMax Display
projects.summary: In full screen, macOS leaves the strip beside the notch black. ProMax Display gives it back: a 14" MacBook Pro goes from a 14.06" screen to the full 14.2". With a rear-view mirror for what's behind the notch, and trackpad gestures for the menu bar and Dock. For MacBooks with a notch or Dynamic Island.

projects.title: BobaNote
projects.summary: BobaNote is a notes app for the Mac menu bar. Rich text, images, video, PDFs, tables, voice memos, subpages and real encryption. Everything stays local: no account, no cloud. Free up to 10 notes, Pro is a one-time €19.95.

projects.title: Binaural ADHD Radio player
projects.summary: Binaural ADHD Radio Player is a simple, free desktop app for Mac and Windows that combines binaural beats with lo-fi music. Choose your binaural background, pick a lo-fi track, adjust the mix, and enjoy your own sound environment while working, studying, or relaxing

projects.title: [开源推荐] Loom：用对话检索、整理和加工本地创作素材
projects.author: Qy-Wen

github.name: Qy-Wen/loom
github.description: Local-first asset library you can browse, search, and edit through chat.

projects.summary: Loom 是面向设计师、摄影师、剪辑师和 AI 创作者的桌面素材工作台。打开已有文件夹，就能预览图片、视频、音频和文档；为素材生成描述并建立索引后，可按画面含义检索。内置 Agent 能通过对话整理文件、调用 FFmpeg 加工媒体，并用关系图串起参考图、生成图和成品。采用 MIT 许可证，提供 macOS 和 Windows 预发布安装包。 亮点 这是我开发的项目，主要想解决创作过程中“素材找不到、整理费时间、参考与成品难以追溯”的问题。 直接使用原有文件夹： 素材保留在本地目录中，元数据、索引、关系和会话保存在素材库的 .loom/ 目录里，方便连同素材一起迁移。 从检索接着做处理： 例如先找“暖色调、有逆光的街景”，再让 Agent 整理文件、从视频截帧或压缩成片，结果回到素材库。语义检索需要先配置模型并为素材生成描述、建立索引。 保留创作脉络： 通过“参考”“派生自”等关系连接素材，在关系图中追溯参考图、生成图与最终成品；还可用自定义表格字段记录审核状态、评分等信息。 可连接外部工具： 通过 MCP 接入 ComfyUI 等创作工具，也可启用本地 MCP 服务，让外部 Agent 检索和管理素材库，相关服务需自行配置。 面向桌面应用开发者： 基于 Electron、React 和 TypeScript，可以参考本地文件管理、媒体预览、Agent 工具调用与 MCP 接入的实现。

projects.title: ChattyDesk
projects.summary: Chat with Claude, GPT, Gemini, Mistral and 400+ more models from one window. Switch model mid-conversation, keep the thread, and reopen anything you asked last week. Runs in the browser or as a desktop app.

projects.title: Deadline Bar
projects.summary: Deadline Bar lives in your Mac’s menu bar: how much time each deadline has left, which one to do next, and a timed session to finish it. Free for five open deadlines, no account.

projects.title: Winter Glow — Christmas iPhone Pack
projects.summary: Winter Glow gives your iPhone a full Christmas makeover in minutes. Two complete themes are inside: Cozy Christmas (warm red, gold and cream) and Winter Frost (ice blue, silver and white). Each has 112 custom icons, widget covers and still wallpapers, plus 12 live wallpapers with falling snow and an 8-page setup guide. Icons install via Shortcuts, no extra app needed. Setup takes under 15 minutes on iOS 17+. Try the free mini pack with 3 live wallpapers first.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Senrelay（续境）：本地优先的 macOS 多 Agent 会话接力与 15 宿主配置工作台
projects.author: qingsongcui

github.name: qingsongcui/ContextCore
github.description: Senrelay · 续境 — Local-first macOS multi-Agent conversation relay, source-linked persistent memory, and unified host configuration workbench.

projects.summary: GitHub 开源协议：MIT（完全免费、无需登录账号、零遥测） 平时高强度用 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Cursor 和 OpenCode 写代码，经常被两件琐事卡住： 1. 额度见底或切换工具时上下文断层：在 Claude Code 里排查完一半的问题，切到 Codex 或 Cursor 又得重新解释背景，很多贴进剪贴板的“自动摘要”还会把关键错误日志或边界条件丢掉； 2. 多宿主配置越改越乱：不同工具的 MCP JSON、TOML 和规则文件路径各不相同，手动修改很容易写坏原有字段或互相覆盖。 所以做了 Senrelay · 续境（ContextCore） —— 一个本地优先（local-first）的 macOS 原生多 Agent 工作台： 单指令跨工具原文接力（/contextcore）：在任意新工具里输入 /contextcore（或直接说“接着做”），先返回简短不掉帧的会话候选表（保留 Git Worktree 分支消歧）；选定后由接手 Agent 通过 readconversationmessages 按预算分页读取原始对话在本地压缩续写，支持“仅复盘待命（mustnotexecute=true）”与 discussiononly 防误改护栏。 双层工作记忆与原文溯源：区分当前任务状态（workingtasks）与长期规范/经验（contents），所有记忆绑定原话引用并支持冲突检测与版本回滚。 15 个编码宿主的事务化配置管理：内置 6 个核心上下文宿主 + 9 个扩展宿主的原生路径解析与结构化写入（支持 JSON / JSONC / JSON5 / TOML / YAML），写入前自动落盘备份快照；本地 FTS5 全文检索（默认不下载外部模型，完全运行在 127.0.0.1）。 安装与适用边界说明 当前 Public Beta（v1.0.0-beta.2）仅支持 Apple Silicon（arm64）macOS 14.0+（Windows/Linux 暂不支持）；安装包采用本地 ad-hoc 签名，首次打开前清一次下载隔离属性即可： bash brew install --cask qingsongcui/tap/senrelay xattr -cr /Applications/Senrelay.app 在线速查文档：15 个 AI 编程宿主配置路径与安全写入规则 实战工作流说明：跨 Agent 会话接力与额度交接指南

projects.title: Mac Ninja
projects.summary: Mac Ninja puts idle browser tabs to sleep and lowers CPU priority for busy background apps. Your tabs stay in place and reload when you return. Open the menu bar dashboard to see what changed. Try it for 7 days, no card required.

projects.title: ATLAS
projects.summary: Use your own Mac from an iPad or iPhone. Open desktop apps, type, click and move files with native controls. Choose Full ATLAS with the Mac companion, or Quick connection through macOS Screen Sharing and verified SSH. Connect over your private network or your own Tailscale setup.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】EmojiBridge：收图、视频转 GIF、漫画配文，做好直接拖出去
projects.author: NEO-SUNXIAOCHUAN

github.name: NEO-SUNXIAOCHUAN/EmojiBridge
github.description: 好梗，不必留在原地。QQ ↔ 微信表情互通、随手素材、视频转 GIF 与创意编辑。Created by Neo.

projects.summary: 大家好，我是 Neo，自荐一下我做的 EmojiBridge：一款免费开源的 Windows 桌面表情包工具，把收集、创作和使用连起来。 平时看到喜欢的表情，收下来之后还要找文件、改字、裁视频，再把成品发出去。我想把这些步骤放进同一个工作空间： 随手收图：图片和 GIF 收进悬浮素材库，浏览其他窗口时也能取用；支持把表情贴到屏幕上移动、缩放。 自己做梗：视频选段、裁剪后生成 GIF，漫画配文、图文拼接，还能给表情添加 Q 弹、旋转等动效。 做好拖出去：从成品拖出区，直接拖到支持接收文件的聊天窗口或文件夹，减少保存后再翻找的步骤。 项目与源码： 功能演示： 收图实录： Windows 下载： 普通用户下载完整包、全部解压后打开 EB/EmojiBridge.exe，不用编译源码。当前完整 ZIP 约 1.35 GB，同版 7z 约 1.19 GB，包含三种抠图模型和默认本地组件；宣传片同款素材包独立可选。 软件也包含 QQ/微信相关功能，兼容性仍在持续打磨：读取 QQ 表情或执行互通时，请不要移动鼠标、点击或切换窗口；转入微信会使用本人的文件传输助手，占用其聊天上下文并产生消息记录。 项目自有源码采用 GPL-3.0-only；第三方代码及素材保留各自许可和来源。 欢迎试用、反馈，也希望这套“收图—做梗—拖出”的流程能帮大家用上自己喜欢的表情。

projects.title: inNote
projects.summary: A lightweight desktop utility for creating digital notes directly on your Windows screen. It brings the aesthetic and simplicity of paper sticky notes to your workspace, backed by total data safety so no idea ever gets lost.

projects.title: Online Keyboard Cleaner
projects.summary: Cleaning a keyboard while the computer is on means stray typing and shortcuts firing. Keyboard Cleaner locks your keyboard in the browser with one click. Wipe every key, watch each one light up on screen, then unlock with your mouse. Free, nothing to install.s your keyboard for safe cleaning.

projects.title: Show HN: Codex sessions in the Mac menu bar
projects.author: shubyhere
projects.summary: I hate notifications, I hate keeping track of Codex sessions so I built this app. I hope you like it!

projects.title: Dynamic Edge
projects.summary: Dynamic Edge brings a Dynamic Island-style experience to Windows 10 and 11. It combines media controls, clipboard history, app and folder launching, timers, volume controls, and more into a lightweight floating interface. Built with native WinUI 3 and Windows App SDK, it is designed to feel at home on Windows without the overhead of Electron. You can dock it to the top, left, or right of your screen, use it across multiple monitors, and quickly summon it with a global hotkey or Magic Shake.

projects.title: Topway
projects.summary: Open source Menu Bar app to monitor your Railway projects and services. MIT-licensed, not affiliated with Railway.

projects.title: Pupil (Desktop)
projects.summary: Pupil is a beautiful, open-source flashcard app that helps you remember everything. Type a topic and AI drafts a deck you approve card by card, or drag in your Anki decks. FSRS spaced repetition brings each card back right before you'd forget it, with stats that surface weak spots. A calm, keyboard-first desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Free and MIT-licensed: no account, no subscription, and your cards stay on your machine.

projects.title: Overheard
projects.summary: A free, open-source Mac menu bar app that records calls without a bot, transcribes them with speakers and timestamps (on-device or in the cloud), summarizes decisions and action items, and makes meetings searchable from Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Codex through an MCP server.

projects.title: TakeFullPage
projects.summary: Most screenshot extensions watermark your images or lock PDF export, blur, and editing behind monthly paywalls. TakeFullPage gives you full-page scrolling capture, selected-area capture, a full annotation editor (arrows, boxes, text, blur redaction), and instant HQ PNG, PDF, clipboard, or Telegram export—100% free and processed locally in your browser.

projects.title: Dotmeter
projects.summary: Dotmeter lives in the menu bar and opens a window for the full picture: which app is using the processor, graphics, memory, disk, network and power, how hot the Mac runs, and what is on every USB port. It also acts on what it shows: uninstall an app with what it left behind, see which ports are open, and find the cable that is slowing a drive down. Ask Claude or GPT about it with your own key. Free, open source, signed and notarized by Apple.

projects.title: DD Photos
projects.summary: DD Photos turns folders of photos and videos into a fast, mobile-friendly album website with no ads or distractions. A free desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux does the setup, and you can publish for free on Cloudflare Pages or Surge. Open source.

projects.title: Show HN: Harness Relay – the coding agents you have, working together
projects.author: cyyeh
projects.summary: If you already have multiple coding agents(one kind of agent also works though), you should really look into this project! It's a desktop app that brings coding agents working together, with user experience similar to ChatGPT! One kind of agent is enough for an agent team: all of one kind, or any mix of Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor Agent, Antigravity, GitHub Copilot CLI, Muse Code and five open-source coding agents on your own model backends. For each question, the lead agent designs the team: each member’s role and model, and how they take turns. Once you confirm it, the real agents on your machine work on your code, or any question, and answer each other. It also supports voice input, notification, branching in conversation, task scheduling, and mobile app(PWA) support! github.description: The review and merge layer for coding agents. Your agents write the code; o8 reviews it, sends it back until it's right, and merges it. Works with Claude Code, Codex, T3 Code and more.

projects.summary: 自荐：我是 o8 的作者。 o8 是一个免费、开源（MIT）的桌面应用，专门负责审查和合并 AI 编程代理写出来的代码。代码可以在任何地方写：Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 或你自己的编辑器。写完交给 o8，由另一个独立的代理（最好是不同的模型）审查真实的 diff，把问题退回给作者修改，修完再审，通过后合并。 写代码的代理不能给自己的代码放行。审查由另一个代理完成，批准结果绑定到它审查的那个 commit，代码再改动，批准就失效。 审查不通过时，问题清单会退回给原作者代理修改，最多两轮，每一步都留有记录。 不绑定模型和工具。o8 调用你机器上已经装好的代理 CLI（Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Gemini、Cursor、Aider 等），用你自己的订阅或 API Key。 可以通过 o8 命令行或任何 MCP 客户端使用。 macOS 14+ 提供签名、自动更新的安装包；Linux 有预览版安装包（AppImage、DEB、RPM）。 目前的进度：审查、退回修改、复审已经在主分支可用；统一的受控合并和按项目规则自动合并还在开发中，路线图在仓库的 ROADMAP.md。欢迎反馈。

projects.title: Show HN: Yet another agent manager (but we needed it)
projects.author: imakris
projects.summary: Hello HN, I am Ioannis and I would like to introduce Logonomic, a desktop application we made to help us work with LLM CLIs (e.g. codex, claude, opencode etc) in a more organized way. It runs the CLIs already installed, with their existing accounts and configuration and organizes sessions by repository. It is available for Windows and Linux, with a preview for macOS. There is also a mobile companion app, to work remotely (Android and soon iOS too). We built it originally to assist us in our own work, to address the common case of multiple agents running concurrently in many repositories. It was hard to keep track of what each one is doing and which one needs attention or requires action. There are many tools by now broadly that broadly target the same problem. This one is a native C++/Qt application with our own terminal emulator. Some of its features: - An 'overview' mode that shows all running sessions, optionally grouped by repository, each with its status, title and summary that the agents update regularly. - Agents add a trailer to their commits, enabling to re-open the conversations that produced them. - Terminals run in their own processes and survive UI crashes. - A plot that shows line counts over time, by directory or language, where clicking on a sample brings up the corresponding commit in the git log. - A treemap that shows how the repo's files are organized, with a diff mode that colours changed files, whose diff opens with a double click. - Token usage and remaining account quotas shown where available, with usage broken down by day and repository. - Sessions can exchange messages (1:1 or broadcast), may hand tasks to each other or continue other session's work. The supported CLIs are Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Antigravity, Grok Build, Kimi Code and Qwen Code. The free edition has no time limit and runs up to four terminals. The paid editions have perpetual one-time licences from €150 for 2 seats and include 12 months of feature updates, no terminal limit, GitHub/GitLab CI integrations, as well as an Android companion app (iOS will follow). The application itself is proprietary. Many of its core components are open source, among them the terminal emulator and the plotting library: https://github.com/Varinomics This is the first public release, so there will be rough edges, and we would like to hear about them.

projects.author: adriant93
projects.summary: I've been a developer for half my life now. I have a metric ton of projects which I've always had a hard time naming and juggling around, my stack has been the same for maybe 5 years now: - Gitkraken for git, along with its profiles to juggle between work, personal and open source - Termius for SSH connections that work on the mobile as well - Jetbrains Toolbox for quickly opening my projects in IDEs I lost my job in December 2025, and when the subscriptions bill came through, I saw it and I decided to build my own. So introducing: BranchBay and BranchShell pretty much. BranchBay is like Gitkraken on steroids - rust drawn, has tabs and groups for grouping repositories, pretty much like Chrome. You can pull tabs out and split into a new session. BranchShell is on mobile + desktop as well, it holds all your SSH, Databases, S3, Port forwarding connections in an encrypted vault locally. Best thing is the tray app which you can quickly press global shortcuts like Cmd+Ctrl+O, and see all the repositories you have, with their profiles, with the groups, and quickly either open it in your favorite IDE or terminal and work with them. Because I built them for myself, to get rid of my own subscriptions, I've decided to put them online for $20 one time payment for 2 machines. The goal is to basically help devs get out of this subscription hell and save some money in the age of AI. The programs have been out for a couple of months now, and I'm using them daily. projects.summary: I'm spending more time in the terminal, and with kitty graphics support now in Ghostty and Rex, I thought a real browser in a coding pane might be possible. It is. kb drives headless Chrome and draws each frame as pixels, so you get the actual page, not a text approximation. Key features: - Built in Rust, on headless Chrome - Keyboard shortcuts, mouse clicks, scroll, zoom, find, copy - Frames can go through the terminal itself, so it should work over SSH CLI, MCP and an agent skill, so your coding agent drives the same page you're watching From its own pane, the agent runs things like: > kb https://news.ycombinator.com/ What I learned: the best way to design a CLI for agents is to watch agents use it. Most of the commands exist because an agent got stuck. I ran multiple agent loops where agents would try to use the documentation, get stuck and itterate on the docs. Note this project needs a terminal with the kitty graphics protocol (Ghostty, kitty, WezTerm, Rex) and Chrome. Tested on macOS; Linux builds but needs testers. Windows PRs welcome. cargo install --git https://github.com/graiz/kittybrowser kb news.ycombinator.com MIT licensed. Feedback welcome.

projects.summary: I run Claude Code on long tasks and walk away. projects.title: Show HN: Turri – a coding agent with the power of regenerative software
projects.author: ponoru

github.name: turri-oss/turri
github.description: the first coding agent with the power of regenerative software

projects.summary: Coding agents let me move fast. To keep up, I stopped reading the code, and with it I stopped understanding my own software. I lost my sense of engineering along with it. I was still the one accountable for software I didn't understand. No workflow or better model fixed that, so I built turri. turri is based on Pi and the concept of regenerative software introduced by Chad Fowler. The ability to regenerate the same piece of code multiple times and always get the same results in terms of functionality is called the deletion test and proves that your coding agent completely understands you. The idea is that every time part of the software needs to be changed, you regenerate a new version of the code based on the durable information you have about the system. The durable system information includes specs, tests, ADRs, and other types of documents, and it is written in ***plain. You write these with the help of an agent, and Turri starts partial regeneration of the software you're changing. You can repeat this process as many times as you want until you're happy with the change you're implementing. The regeneration also includes proofs that the generated code completely conforms to the system knowledge on which it was based (it implements all the tests that are part of the definition and automatically adds additional tests). You can try this by cloning the repo or by installing it from my landing page. I created a desktop app to improve usability. Currently, it's only suitable for new projects, but I'm working on adding support for existing projects. I also wrote the full story in case you're interested: https://turri.dev/blog/why-i-built-turri/

github.name: p-nickzhang-q/kura

projects.summary: 【开源自荐】Kura：把乱成一堆的影视文件整理成 Emby / Jellyfin 认得出的目录 Kura 是一个本地影片库管理器：Electron 桌面应用 + 一个给 agent 用的 CLI，共享一份 TypeScript core 和一个 SQLite 文件。 它解决的问题：影视文件的命名千奇百怪，Emby / Jellyfin 认不出来，只能手动改名、建目录、找封面。Kura 做三件事，互不触发： scan 只读磁盘：登记文件、解析季集号、建条目占位 scrape 只读网络：从 TMDB 取元数据 organize 默认 dry-run，--apply 才动文件 整理后的形状：剧名 (年)/Season 01/剧名 - S01E01.mkv 技术上值得一提的几点 没有服务端，没有守护进程。打开才运行，关了就退出。GUI 和 CLI 不走端口，只共享一个 SQLite 文件 CLI 是给 agent 写的：kura schema --json 自描述命令清单，退出码是主信号（0 成功 / 2 用法错 / 3 可重试 / 4 需要人 / 5 不存在 / 10 内部 bug），stdout 只放数据、日志走 stderr。参数解析、--help 和 schema 共用同一份声明，所以永远不会不同步 NFO 双向同步：库里有网络来源就写回 nfo，没有就从 nfo 补空字段。换一台电脑接上同一块硬盘，kura nfo recover 能直接从盘上的 nfo 重建整个库，不用重刮。读的时候只认白名单字段 —— Emby 写的 <playcount> / <watched> 在类型上就进不来 不猜：认不出集号的文件留在原地等人来绑，TMDB 搜索结果永远由人挑。认错了会让整季集名全错，代价比多花两分钟大 整理时目标已存在同名文件一律 skip，绝不覆盖

projects.title: Show HN: Yogurt – Free, private, open-source alternative to Granola
projects.author: brownrout
projects.summary: Hey HN, I’m Eric and I want to share an OSS project that I’ve been building in my free time. Yogurt is a free, MIT licensed desktop app that uses on-device AI models to transcribe, summarize, and chat with your meetings. Similar to Granola, Yogurt runs in the background and does not join your calls. But unlike Granola, Yogurt is open-source, free to use, and private. Your meeting transcripts, call recordings, and summaries never leave your computer. As small OSS models have gotten faster and more powerful, Yogurt seemed like a pretty obvious win for privacy and cost conscious folks. You do not need a frontier model to summarize meeting notes or answer questions about them. And if you want to make your notes available to a frontier model, you can just share it with Anthropic, OpenAI, etc. directly via Yogurt’s local MCP server. There’s no need to use a paid cloud service as a middleman. I tried some of the most popular OSS note taking tools, and most were missing features like calendar integration, MCP server, etc. or required you to connect or create an account. And more than that, they didn’t feel polished enough for it to be something I actually wanted to use daily, and so I built Yogurt to scratch that itch. I spent a lot of time fine-tuning every UI interaction/animation and optimizing the model calls to get the most out of your hardware + make it snappy. To support Windows/Mac/Linux, I decided to go with Electron. I use whisper.cpp for transcription and Apple’s on-device SpeechAnalyzer if your system supports it. For call summaries and questions, I use a local open weight LLM that automatically gets downloaded and set up based on what your hardware can handle without your cooling fans firing off like crazy (this part uses llama.cpp). I’ve spent a lot of time working on details like echo detection/reduction, global/folder/local level search respectively, and auto-end recordings. Hope this is useful for any of you who have held out on using AI note tools for privacy or cost reasons, or for folks using cloud tools who want to switch to something free and open source that still feels great to use. Would love to hear what you think about the onboarding and note taking experience :)

projects.title: Show HN: Mimzie, an agent-neutral alternative to the Claude Suite/Claude Cowork
projects.author: kyleandruczk
projects.summary: hi HN! I built Mimzie, an agent neutral AI workspace inspired by the Claude Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and Cowork. It's a free desktop app that runs ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok in their native CLI harnesses. Think T3 Code or Conductor but for knowledge work. It's basically a GUI for managing knowledge work agents in various form factors. One of those form factors is Bots, akin to Grok Bot or Dots. The original idea for mimzie was simple: I pay for Claude and ChatGPT, and a lot of my day-to-day work lives in .xlsx, .pptx and .docx files. Moreover, I was sick and tired of losing context between AI platforms. I didn't want to bet the house on one AI lab's product, be it the ChatGPT or the Claude Desktop app. So I built an AI desktop app that was agent neutral. The goal of mimzie is to bring the kind of agent workflows that devs have had with codex and claude code into the hands of everyone. And to have a friendly GUI to do it. I've found that the personal agents, hermes and openclaw, are intimidating to set up and confusing to the average non-technical person. some of the core principles of mimzie: - your file stays your file: edits are done locally and .docx, .pptx, .xlsx, and .md and synced to the cloud after - every change is reviewable: edits show up as tracked diffs that you accept or reject, at the smallest unit that makes sense (e.g. a sentence in .docx) - free, and no new subscription needed: bring whichever AI plan or plans you already have. You shouldn't have to pay twice for the same inference, and you SHOULD take advantage of the insane subsidization in the current ChatGPT and Claude plans. - Bots with any AI: I love the concept of grok bot, not so much its limited choice of models. I strongly believe that long-standing "ai teammates" should be agent neutral and in your control Try mimzie out: it's a free beta at mimzie.com it's early, lots of rough edges, but I've had the time of my life developing it. I'd love to answer questions and hear any and all feedback.

projects.summary: PiBrowse 是基于 Fury 持续开发的开源指纹浏览器，采用 AGPL-3.0-or-later 协议，可管理彼此隔离的浏览器环境。开源版承诺永远免费下载、本地使用和自部署。当前 v0.5.5 提供 Mac Apple Silicon 桌面预览包，以及重新编译、统一 PiBrowse 品牌的 Chromium 157.0.8103.39 内核；保留环境快速创建、高级配置、排序、置顶、保存视图和自定义列等日常管理功能。 亮点 1. 开源与永久免费：开源版承诺永远免费下载、本地使用和自部署，用户可以查看源码并参与改进。 2. 更简单的环境创建：提供快速创建与高级设置，可随机选择设备指纹；关闭窗口时保护未保存草稿。 3. 面向日常使用的环境列表：支持最近使用、需处理、标签和阶段筛选、排序、置顶、保存视图和自定义列，方便整理多个浏览器环境。 4. v0.5.5 品牌与内核更新：桌面、文档和重新编译的 Chromium 157.0.8103.39 内核统一用户可见的 PiBrowse 名称及内部产品图标。客户端可从本项目的 GitHub Releases 下载并安装匹配内核。 5. 明确的上游来源：PiBrowse 基于 Fury，保留原作者版权署名和兼容性标识；技术栈包括 Rust、Tauri、React 和 TypeScript。 当前状态：v0.5.5 为 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）预览版，本次不提供 Windows 或 Intel Mac 客户端。桌面与内核采用 ad-hoc 签名，尚无 Apple Developer ID 签名及 Apple 公证，macOS 可能阻止首次打开；应用使用手动更新。PiBrowse Cloud 为独立、可选的托管服务，目前仍在开发。 下载与安装 所有安装包均托管在 GitHub Releases；官网的两个下载按钮也直接链接到以下 GitHub 下载 PiBrowse v0.5.5 桌面安装包（macOS arm64，.dmg） 下载 Chromium 157.0.8103.39 内核（macOS arm64，.tar.xz） SHA-256 校验文件 v0.5.5 发布说明、安装限制与验收记录 打开桌面下载包，将 PiBrowse.app 拖入 Applications；启动后点击「下载浏览器」安装匹配内核，也可手动导入单独下载的内核包。

Agent 就是业务前端：没有日常业务录入页面，员工直接用自己惯用的 Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw、Hermes 或任意 MCP 客户端，用自然语言完成报工时、贴发票报销、拟报价单、核对采购三单匹配、预留库存并过账发货；React Console 仅保留给管理员做团队配置、权限管控和审计回看。 2. 业务规则是带版本的自然语言，而不是 if/else：审批流、折扣红线、数据校验规范以纯文本形式存储在版本化、带生效日期的 businessrules 表中，流程位置由只追加的 approvalrecords 与 todos 实时推导——调整审批路线只需对管理员 Agent 说一句话，无需改代码或重新发布。 3. 零 SDK 的 SKILL.md + HTTP（并原生内置 OAuth 2.1 POST /mcp）：员工本地 Agent 通过浏览器 Device Flow（oryh-connect）授权一次，即可自动拉取与其 RBAC 角色严格匹配的 Markdown 技能包和 OpenAPI 契约；服务端通过 PostgreSQL Row-Level Security（RLS）、不可篡改明细账本及账期锁定兜底，确保 Agent 无论怎么理解上下文都无法越权写坏账。 单租户完整功能开箱自托管（docker compose up -d --build，支持可选执行 scripts/seedsample.py 一键加载虚构公司样例数据进行体验）。欢迎大家体验和指正！

projects.title: Show HN: Darkroomfinder.org – A Directory of Photography Darkrooms
projects.author: stokesj84
projects.summary: I built darkroomfinder.org, a directory of photography darkrooms, as a React single page app (SPA), because I wanted to understand how SPAs work and I wanted to scale to hundreds or thousands of cities without managing routes and pages for each of them. The site currently lists over 350 darkrooms across over 50 countries. However in deciding to build a SPA I failed to realize the downsides of SPAs for SEO. As an SPA darkroomfinder.org only has one route, i.e. darkroomfinder.org. Therefore GoogleBot only indexes the root domain and if someone searches for "Darkrooms" the site might surface in Google Search, but if a user searches "San Francisco Darkrooms" Google Search is much less likely to return darkroomfinder.org as nothing indicates the site has information about San Francisco. Solving this SEO problem while maintaining the simplicity of the SPA turned out to be a challenge but I think I have arrived at a solution that checks most of the desired boxes at the cost of being tied more closely to Cloudflare's infrastructure. Cloudflare, the DNS and CDN for darkroomfinder.org, has a serverless primitive, Cloudflare Workers. These Cloudflare Workers are distributed at the edge, have KV caches, and can intercept specific paths. So my solution to having both an SPA and indexable city routes is to have Cloudflare Workers cache the city data and intercept city routes directed at darkroomfinder.org returning an HTML page with the city data and the full React SPA which boots over the HTML page. So technically it's one SPA served to many routes. GoogleBot in traversing one of these city routes, like darkroomfinder.org/san-francisco, will index the HTML page while humans using browsers receive the same HTML which the React SPA boots over. Part of the project that remains unsolved is data collection and validation. Darkroom discovery is automated by agents running daily scans for unlisted darkrooms. But a human still has to validate that the discovered darkrooms exist and try to determine what capabilities they have such as B&W or color developing etc. I am currently working on an automated reachability and vitality checker to determine if the darkrooms already in the directory are still active, since photography darkrooms sometimes cease operations long before taking down their websites or social feeds. darkroomfinder.org

projects.title: DocuKit — choose your language
projects.author: jeffery
projects.summary: # DocuKit — 在浏览器里把文档转成图片 **PDF / Word 转 PNG、JPG，全程在你的浏览器标签页里完成。不上传、不注册、无水印，最高 600 DPI。** ## 为什么做它 投简历的时候，招聘平台和 HR 经常要求把简历转成 PNG 或 JPG。截图发过去糊得看不清，WPS 导出图片要另外收费，各种在线转换站又要求先上传文件、排队、看广告 同样的情况反复发生了几次，我意识到缺的不是"转换功能"，而是一个**不用上传、打开就能用**的工具。 ## 主要功能 - **PDF → PNG / JPG**：基于 pdf.js 在本地渲染，30 页的文档也不用等服务器 - **DOCX → PNG / JPG**：还原 Word 排版后按页切片，尽量贴近原件观感 - **96 / 150 / 300 / 600 四档 DPI** + JPG 质量滑杆，屏幕阅读到印刷输出都覆盖 - **多页合并长图**：竖排或横排拼接，自动裁掉页边距白边，可设置间距 - **批量处理**：多文件一次转换，逐张下载或整体打包 ZIP，结果支持预览、复制到剪贴板 ## 技术要点 - 纯前端实现，PDF 走原生渲染、DOCX 走排版后截图两条路线 - Word 在浏览器里没有固定分页，按内容高度动态切片，让页数和 Word 保持一致 - 600 DPI 下按画布像素上限动态降采样，在清晰度和内存之间取平衡 - 中英双语、按页更新进度、额度用尽时自动回退本地转换 - 部署在 Cloudflare Pages，配了站点地图、双语 hreflang 和 IndexNow ## 使用与边界 打开 https://docukit.win 拖入文件即可，无需注册、无需邀请码。 已知限制：Word 仅支持 .docx，单文件上限 200 MB；复杂分栏、文本框、页眉页脚的还原可能与 Word 有偏差，纯文字和简单表格最稳。另外有一个可选的「高保真模式」会把文件发送到第三方服务处理，默认关闭，处理敏感文件时请保持关闭。 **在线体验：** https://docukit.win

projects.title: Show HN: Lettercamp – open-source static blog framework
projects.author: justswim
projects.summary: Hi HN, I’m Eric and I’m building Lettercamp, an open-source static blog framework. The repo is at https://github.com/lettercamp/lettercamp and the homepage is online at https://www.lettercamp.com . Writing good content has always been the #1 way that I’ve grown the reach of products I’ve worked on in the past. However, it’s always bothered me how many little things get in the way of writing and publishing high quality, first party content onto the web. Building a performant, SEO-optimized blog from scratch was always distracting from development on the actual product, and setting up a 3rd party CMS meant that my content always lived in someone else’s database. Storing content in a non-markdown format also made it difficult to draft and edit with the help of an AI agent. Lettercamp is a modern approach to creating a content site. It ships with all the little features you’d expect in a blog: pagination, authors, metadata, search, cross linking, related posts and more. It’s also statically built, which means that all your content lives in markdown in your codebase, so a deployed version is performant with no database to maintain. This means that you can focus on writing good content instead of vibe-coding a whole blog. I want to add more features to the framework over time, including better support for AI agents, built in localization, email sign ups, and more. The repo is released under the MIT license so that anyone can use the framework to create a content site. The goal isn’t to charge individual developers. The monetization path is to provide a cloud hosted version, that has an online editor that content teams can use. The main advantage of this is to decouple the blog from product deploys, so that teams can publish content without needing to push code. I would love to get your feedback on if this is a problem that might resonate with you or your team. I know that a lot of products create a /blog section at some point, and I wonder what solutions people are using today. My hope is that over time, Lettercamp can be the go-to solution for teams looking to set this up. Try it out: https://github.com/lettercamp/lettercamp and let me know what you think!

projects.title: 我做了一个不太一样的记账 App：它把个人财务变成了一场自己的「金融市场」
projects.author: lidinghui
projects.summary: 有时候，我觉得自己的钱挺神秘的。 明明工资按时到账，也没买什么特别贵的东西，但每个月总有那么几天，打开银行 App ，看着余额陷入沉思： 钱呢？ 我试着回忆这个月买过什么，脑子里只有几杯咖啡、几顿外卖和一些当时觉得很需要的东西。 单笔看起来都没什么问题，合起来就不太对劲了。 ![图片 2]( https://i.imgur.com/gnoLd1I.png) 我们每天都在记录这些变化，只不过大多数记账 App 最后给我们的，还是一张张账单和几个统计数字。 所以，我决定试着做点不一样的东西。 于是我开始想：如果能像看股票行情一样，看看自己的钱每天都发生了什么变化，会不会有意思得多？ 最开始只是一个想法：既然股票有行情，为什么自己的账户不能也有？ 于是，我开始把个人财务和金融市场的一些概念结合起来。 这就是 PFEx 的由来。 它本质上是一个记账 App ，不过有点不一样。 在 PFEx 里，每个账户都有自己的 K 线，可以观察余额走势、成交量和变化趋势。多个账户汇集起来，又会形成一条整体资产曲线。 收入、支出和账户间转账会被分别处理，资金流向也能通过桑基图直观呈现。除此之外，还有周期预算、专项计划、账户表现、龙虎榜和 AI 生成的财务研报。 如果不想自己翻数据，也可以直接和对话 Agent 聊天。查账、分析资金变化，甚至让它协助记录交易。当然，涉及账务修改时，仍然需要经过你的确认。 我甚至给自己的钱安排了一个研究部。 当然，我并不是想把生活变成一场股票交易，也不希望以后买杯奶茶都要先做一份投资分析。 真正有意思的，是看清自己的钱发生了什么变化，以及这些变化背后的习惯、欲望和选择。 毕竟，研究市场是为了理解别人的公司，研究自己的钱，大概是为了少一些月底看余额时的困惑。 如果你也觉得这个想法有点意思，欢迎试试，也欢迎告诉我你的看法。 官网： https://greyglow.cn/pfex/ Google Play： https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=pfex.greyglow.cn

projects.title: Show HN: Plot, a 3D project tracker in your Chrome new tab
projects.author: phinoda
projects.summary: Hey HN , I made Plot because I kept losing track of my own projects. It's easy nowadays to have 10 vibe-coded projects running simultaneously, but once you have so many projects going on, it's very hard to stay on top of them. You reply to a question Claude asked about Project A, open Project B to debug a little bit, shifting to Project C, build a marketing page, and when you go back to Project A, you've already forget where you left off, what you were going to do next, or why you decided to use that library. I made Plot to help with that. It’s a Chrome extension that opens in your new tab, so you can't miss it. Here’s what you can do with it: - In the 2D view, you can resize each project’s plot. Make the ones you want to focus on bigger, and the others smaller. - In the 3D view, each project is a building. The more tasks you finish and the more decisions and learnings you record, the taller it grows. You can see where you’ve been putting your effort. - Click into a project to manage its backlog and to-dos, keep a record of what you’ve shipped, and write down decisions and learnings. Markdown is supported. - In Stats, you can see your recent activity across projects. You can also click a date on the calendar to look back at what you were doing that day. - There’s no AI feature in it. Everything is stored locally in your browser. I wanted something lightweight and easy to use that helps me keep track of what I’m building, and looks pretty cool while doing it.

projects.title: Show HN: App to help parents find, plan, and review outings with their kids
projects.author: brendanperry
projects.summary: Background: My wife and I have 4 boys 4 and under, so we have to get them out of the house consistently to stay sane. Finding good places to take them can be a frustrating process that involves digging through Facebook groups and Google/Yelp reviews that aren't always relevant for parents. The idea: An app that has reviews of places to take your kids by parents. No AI generated magic, just real people documenting their experience. Sproutings has a map of places parents have been with some ideas for new places to try. You can also coordinate outings with other parents using an outing planning tool. The challenge: I sat on this idea for a long time because of the challenge that is mapping data. The best POI source you can think of is Google, but their terms are unfriendly and prices don't work for an indie dev. Other better priced options still do not let you store the POI data from their API in your own database. I was determined to have my own map view of all of the places people have reviewed, so I needed coordinates. The tech: My solution to this was a postgres database full of data I imported and filtered from OSM. This gives me full control over the data to with what I want. So now I have a really cool map view with pins that can scale to millions with no problem using pmtiles. The client side is built with React Native. This was just so I could easily launch on web and mobile. On web, RN has a hard time with SEO, so I had to display some raw HTML / CSS here and there. There are also plenty of challenges with bugs that would only appear on certain platforms, so keeping everything aligned was a constant game of whack-a-mole. Conclusion: I have a picture in my mind of a Sproutings map overflowing with places reviewed by parents, but the reality is that we have a chicken and egg problem. A platform that relies on user engagement to provide value isn't valuable until people have engaged. However, I'm hoping that I can reach more and more parents that would find it valuable and continue to expand its reach. I'd love to hear of any and all feedback! Thanks for reading.

projects.title: Show HN: Zeus – Claude Code for AI voice agents
projects.author: kolchinski
projects.summary: Hey, Alex here, I'm one of the founders. We've built phone agents for enterprise customers for two years and kept seeing the same failure: agents that mishear callers and then do something confidently wrong. We're announcing two things in this launch. #1 is the stack: instead of one transcription model → one LLM → one TTS, most conversation turns runs through several transcription models and LLMs (a fast and a slow LLM in the same call, models switched per turn, audio sent straight to an LLM alongside transcripts). That gets us 99.4% on Big Bench Audio. That's the second-highest published score; the only model above us takes almost 9 seconds to start talking as far as we've measured, which doesn't work on a phone call. Eval set and transcripts are on Hugging Face - http://huggingface.co/datasets/kolchinski/bba-storm-eval #2 is Zeus, an agent that configures our voice AI stack per use case and per conversation. We tried doing this with Claude Code and Codex and they were bad at it: they can't run simulated calls out of the box, don't do well with audio input and spotting problems in calls, and tend to blindly believe vendor marketing about which model is best vs actually trying the models. Zeus has evals on real calls, can simulate calls in hard situations, and listens to production calls to find problems, so it can check its own work the way a coding agent runs tests to make sure the code it wrote actually works. Pricing is cost-plus (vendor prices + hosting + a 17–25% margin), no subscription. Zeus is free for now. You can try it with a free $10 credit. Happy to answer questions.

projects.title: Show HN: EarthData – find places to visit or live that match what you care about
projects.author: 11thEarlOfMar
projects.summary: Hi HN, A few years ago, I was trying to find the place on Earth that had the optimal combination of attributes to vacation to or live. I couldn't find anything that wasn't a marketing funnel or was limited in geography. So I built EarthData essentially for myself, but others might find it useful. There are two modes: "visit" for a trip (travel month, length of stay, things to do) and "live" for relocation or retirement (housing, healthcare, day-to-day fit). The way it operates is to allow the user to sculpt the attributes they care about in where they visit on vacation or live. Rate and rank what matters to you. And it will returns 10 initial places, down to specific towns, with a written explanation of why each one fits. From there, the user can expand on places that look interesting, and ultimately pull a TRIP KIT with full itinerary, web links to venues, packing list and other information. A few design choices: - It's anonymous. No account, no email required, and preferences live in your browser's local storage. Nothing is tied to a named profile, your preferences are sent to xAI's API to generate matches, but without any PII. - No ads and no advertising cookies. - I went with a mid-century travel graphic design. To me, it evokes nostalgia and romance for international travel. - It supports 10 different languages. - The initial top 10 Matching is free. The only paid part is an optional $3.75 trip kit for a single place (itinerary, 10 matched activities, checklist, PDF). It covers the Google Places API costs for venues and links, which seem oddly 'expensive'. - Matching uses an LLM (currently xAI's Grok) to generate and reason about candidates, which get shaped into place cards, maps, short videos and activities. One area I struggled with was how to group and refine the attribute selections. Higher slider levels reveal finer-grained choices and give that topic more weight. So if it matters a lot, you can really dial in what you're looking for. If it doesn't matter to you, you can skip entirely. If you see any that seem out of line, please point it out. It was a lot of work to make sense with the slider settings, and I'm not convinced it's dialed in. Finally, if you're looking for something that doesn't have a selection, you can free-form a must-have before submitting. Feedback welcome!

projects.title: [分享创造] 一个带来源分级与保鲜机制的海外项目数据集（41 项目 / 136 来源，开源 + 双语站）
projects.summary: 做这个小东西的起因很具体：在给自己查 2027 年 J-1 的资格，发现中文世界关于「打工度假 / 海外实习签证」的信息有一个系统性问题—— 把只对中国台湾、中国香港护照开放的项目，写成「中国公民可申请」。加拿大 IEC 、英国 YMS 、爱尔兰 WHA 、日本 WH 、韩国 H-1 都属于双边互惠协议，中国大陆护照不在名单内。这类错误在攻略、中介软文、AI 生成内容里反复出现。 于是我把它当成一个数据工程问题来做，而不是又一个攻略站。 是什么 开源数据集 + 一个双语静态站。41 个项目、21 个国家和地区、136 条来源，其中中国大陆护照可申 34 个、不可申 7 个（不可申的也明确收录，作为排除记录）。 站： https://eddieye1004.github.io/overseas-program-dataset/ 库： https://github.com/eddieye1004/overseas-program-dataset 怎么做的 1) schema 先行。每个项目一个 JSON ，字段定义在 data/schema.json ，护照资格是第一等公民（ passport_types 决定 90% 的结论）。 2) 来源分级 + CI 强制。每条来源标 primary/secondary ，并按域名分 A/B/C/D 四级：A 是移民局/使领馆/官方法规库，D 是百科、自媒体、商业博客。D 级出现即 CI 失败，全部来源都不到 A/B 级也失败。二手来源不能单独支撑硬性资格判定。 3) 保鲜靠台账而不是靠人记。每条记录带 last_verified 。scripts/track.py 按项目性质分档：窗口写死到具体日期的 90 天复核、其余 180 天，剩余不足 25% 提前标「即将到期」。 产物两份：tracking.json 给程序读，FRESHNESS.md 给人读。CI 每周一跑 --check ，超期即退出码 1 把构建打红；另有一个脚本把同一份台账同步成一张 issue （固定标题 + 固定标签，先搜后改，不刷屏），让「红了」这件事真的有人看到。 4) 配额四态化（刚做完的一轮）。原来是「整数或 null 」，而 null 同时兼指「无名额上限 / 官方设限额但未公布 / 还没查」三种，读的人分不出来——他根本不知道自己看到的那一格是「没有上限」还是「没查」。 现在改成一个必填的状态字段，四态：有具体配额 / 无配额 / 官方未公布数字 / 待核实。凡断言前三态都必须指向本项目已有的一条 primary 来源，指不出来就只能写「待核实」。当前分布 4 / 34 / 1 / 2 。 两条「待核实」我没有硬凑数字——一个是奥地利红白红卡高资质档，NAG 有联邦最高限额制度，但这一档是否在限额之内、当年数字多少，官网几个页面都查不到；一个是德国机会卡，法条只授权联邦政府可限量、本身不设数字，配套条例经查不存在。这两条就挂在待办清单里，不写成「无配额」。 现在的状态 validate 严格模式 0 错 0 警； 135 个 Python 测试； e2e 212 条断言；前端 tsc/smoke/build 全绿。 窗口日历也做成了硬分区：41 个项目里 3 个能给出官方已公布的日期、2 个只敢按往年规律推断、36 个无从判断——这 36 个里有 32 个本身就是滚动受理、没有固定窗口，其余可查的已逐个核查并在条目里写明卡点。推断与「无从判断」两块在页面上永不出现具体日期。 没有 star 数可以报，也没有用户量可以报——就是我自己在用的一个库。 想求什么反馈 1) 数据纠错入口刚上线（结构化 issue 表单，必填官方来源），最想要的是**挑错**：哪条资格写错了、哪条链接死了、哪个数字过期了。附上官方页面链接就行。 表单： https://github.com/eddieye1004/overseas-program-dataset/issues/new?template=data-correction.yml 2) 来源分级的标准是否合理——特别是「高校官方部门算 C 级、只能作旁证」这条，我拿不准是不是过于严格。 3) 如果你在做同类项目，想听你怎么解决「保鲜」这件事。 不做的事也写清楚：不代办、不做中介导流、不提供「你该申哪个」的建议。这是信息汇编，判断留给你自己。

projects.title: Show HN: EarthData – find places to visit or live that match what you care about
projects.author: 11thEarlOfMar
projects.summary: Hi HN, A few years ago, I was trying to find the place on Earth that had the optimal combination of attributes to vacation to or live. I couldn't find anything that wasn't a marketing funnel or was limited in geography. So I built EarthData essentially for myself, but others might find it useful. There are two modes: "visit" for a trip (travel month, length of stay, things to do) and "live" for relocation or retirement (housing, healthcare, day-to-day fit). The way it operates is to allow the user to sculpt the attributes they care about in where they visit on vacation or live. Rate and rank what matters to you. And it will returns 10 initial places, down to specific towns, with a written explanation of why each one fits. From there, the user can expand on places that look interesting, and ultimately pull a TRIP KIT with full itinerary, web links to venues, packing list and other information. A few design choices: - It's anonymous. No account, no email required, and preferences live in your browser's local storage. Nothing is tied to a named profile, your preferences are sent to xAI's API to generate matches, but without any PII. - No ads and no advertising cookies. - I went with a mid-century travel graphic design. To me, it evokes nostalgia and romance for international travel. - It supports 10 different languages. - The initial top 10 Matching is free. The only paid part is an optional $3.75 trip kit for a single place (itinerary, 10 matched activities, checklist, PDF). It covers the Google Places API costs for venues and links, which seem oddly 'expensive'. - Matching uses an LLM (currently xAI's Grok) to generate and reason about candidates, which get shaped into place cards, maps, short videos and activities. One area I struggled with was how to group and refine the attribute selections. Higher slider levels reveal finer-grained choices and give that topic more weight. So if it matters a lot, you can really dial in what you're looking for. If it doesn't matter to you, you can skip entirely. If you see any that seem out of line, please point it out. It was a lot of work to make sense with the slider settings, and I'm not convinced it's dialed in. Finally, if you're looking for something that doesn't have a selection, you can free-form a must-have before submitting. Feedback welcome!

As you can imagine, this was inconvenient and became time consuming. I tried keeping the games in my own calendar for the season, typing them in myself. But the entries kept needing to change: broadcasters reschedule games, cup draws add new fixtures partway through the season, the Playoff in the American major leagues starts, etc. Every time that happened, I had to go back and fix it by hand. So I built Matchday. It streamlines all of that, keeping you up to date with all of your teams' games right from your own calendar. Not another app, just a calendar I already look at every day, and the games stay up to date on their own. I tried to make a straightforward UX (and probably failed): You pick your teams, set an optional name for the calendar feed, select the Calendar type, then subscribe in it. In case of European clubs, you can mark them as "follow everywhere" and you get all their different cup games as well. Currently it supports men's and women's football, NHL, NBA, WNBA, and NFL. If somebody is interested, following a national football team is completely free, no email is needed. Otherwise, at least an email is required. I started building it for the World Cup, and was quite popular amongst my friends and colleagues but it is still a super small side project and I would appreciate any feedback, especially on the UX side.

projects.title: 一天上线了一个 Roblox 新游戏的资料站
projects.author: yuchuan520
projects.summary: 最近 Roblox 上有个 JoJo 题材的新游戏 Stand Out 很火，同时在线 5 万多人，官方 Discord 17 万多成员。这类 Roblox 游戏的官方资料一般放在 Trello 上，但 Trello 的内容在 Google 里几乎搜不到（搜索结果只显示 "No information is available for this page"），手机上翻 1000 多张卡片也很痛苦。 所以做了一个非官方的资料站：https://standout-trello.com 目前有这些内容： - 兑换码：按官方 Trello 里 Active / Expired 两个分组来区分，附兑换步骤和"码用不了"排查表 - 全部 Stand：45 个已上线的 Stand，可按稀有度筛选，写了每个怎么获得 - 箭的种类：6 种道具的合成配方、排除的稀有度、官方公布的概率 - 更新日志、Wiki 索引、Discord 真假辨别 几个做的时候的体会： 1. 数据准确比内容多重要。上线当天官方就换了一块新 Trello 板，旧板停更；同一天还有 3 个兑换码过期。好几个竞品站还把过期码列成可用。所以每个页面底部都列了数据来自哪几张 Trello 卡片、什么时候核对的，读者可以自己点过去验证。 2. Trello 公开板可以直接读 JSON（/1/boards/{id}/cards），写了个同步脚本，只更新事实字段，人工补充的内容保留不覆盖。 3. 技术栈：Next.js 静态导出 + Cloudflare Pages，代码放 GitLab。整站静态，移动端 Lighthouse 基本都在 97–100。下一步准备用 Cloudflare 定时触发重新构建，构建时自动拉 Trello 数据，这样兑换码过期能几小时内同步。 站是非官方的，和开发团队没有关系。欢迎提意见，也欢迎做游戏站的朋友交流。

projects.summary: 一个纯本地音乐播放器（iPhone / iPad / Apple 芯片 Mac），无账号、无广告、不上传音频。1.7.3 共 19 处改动，补的是几件一直欠着的事：能播的格式少一块、桌面上没得用、从服务器拿歌得先存到「文件」。 格式：MP3 / M4A / MP4 / AAC / FLAC / ALAC / WAV / AIFF·AIF / CAF / MP1·MP2 / OGG·OGA / Opus / DSF·DFF / APE；APE 与 FLAC 内嵌 CUE 也认，旁边放 .lrc 就是逐行歌词。另有 10 段参数均衡器与 ReplayGain。 ![](https://i.imgur.com/bkiQd0O.png) ## 1.7.3 更新 1. APE 现在能直接播（Pro）。不是导入时先转一道 WAV，是边读边解码：后台线程按块取 PCM 进环形缓冲，均衡器和播放器照常取数据，全程没有中间文件。为什么不做缓存转码——APE 无损，一首五分钟解成 WAV 就是 50–100MB，一张专辑几百兆，首次播放还得等转完；实测解码速度是实时的 20–100 倍，余量足够，没必要拿磁盘换时间。代价是只做立体声：多声道的 APE（DVD-A 抓的那种）直接拒绝播放，不静默下混。 2. 整轨 + .cue 的专辑按曲目分开。APE 与 FLAC 内嵌的 CUE 也认，不用在文件旁边再放一份。 3. Mac 上原生运行。不另做一套 Mac 界面，同一份工程跑在 Apple 芯片的 Mac 上，曲库、播放器、Wi-Fi 传歌、导入全是 iPad 那一套；长页面可以按住鼠标拖动滚动，和系统里其它应用一致。取舍：需要 Apple 芯片的 Mac，Intel 机器不在范围内。 4. WebDAV 导入。浏览服务器目录，挑文件或整个文件夹，落到本地和「文件」导入走同一条管线——命名、去重、元数据、CUE 展开都一致，不会出现「服务器来的歌和本地的不一样」。服务器密码进钥匙串，不写明文配置。取舍：单向的「挑一次、落到本地」，不做双向同步，也不扫你服务器上的整个曲库。 5. 睡眠定时独立成页（Pro）：圆环选时长，1 分钟到 14 小时，结束前淡出；倒计时可以暂停，想多听两首按一下，不用重设。 6. iPad / Mac 键盘快捷键：空格播放暂停，⌘← ⌘→ 切歌，⇧⌘← ⇧⌘→ 快进快退，⌘R 切循环、⌘S 切随机；设置里新增一页列全。 7. 其余几处：音频或整个文件夹拖到文件夹页即导入；长按一首歌直接改标题、歌手、专辑、封面；歌单、收藏和自定义标题导出成带版本号的文件，换设备导回去；「存储」页拆开显示音频、封面、歌词、数据和缓存各占多少；关联文件夹保留目录结构，新文件不用手动重扫；文件在 App 外被改名或移动后，歌单按路径 → 文件名 → 标题与歌手三步找回；搜索更快，大小写和变音符号都不敏感；歌单页加了「最近播放」。 8. 修了几处老毛病。最要紧的是换 Apple 账号后 Pro 不再消失：只有商店明确告知「已撤销」才锁回免费，账号切换、离线、商店没回应都保留上一次判定——宁可晚锁一个退款的，也不误锁一个付过钱的。另外修了：中日韩标签的曲名不再变问号；同时带新旧标题标签的歌显示正确标题；横屏在歌词处下滑能收起播放器；系统关掉实时活动时，锁屏歌词页会说明原因并给出开关入口。 免费下载；Pro 一次性买断，不订阅。DSD 与 APE 播放、保存自己的 EQ 调音、播放倍速、睡眠定时、全部主题与播放器样式、备用图标与自定义封面、三行锁屏歌词在 Pro 里，其余都能免费用。 ## 送 10 个码 ``` 8EKFE6TETNPAFN6TKH TPH66L6FMHRTM773XF 4L4W4XL3F7XWTTWETA MAPF4Y3TR3FP4K7FPL 86ET78FWRRXARMNXKP MKYRXKJMHWLTKX7JPF HHRHENAW7834HTRR7M AMEHKARATPTWXA8XNJ WMPER7TRL7XN6AKPT8 L37NTNEFJFK7EWEPR7 ``` 有问题大家可以进群反馈 ![](https://i.imgur.com/vcwUVqA.png)

projects.title: Show HN: Hello Triangle, a puzzle game where you build a GPU
projects.author: icedlatte
projects.summary: I've been working on a game Hello Triangle for a while. In the game, you build a GPU one part at a time by wiring circuits, and renders a picture on the screen with what your circuit computes. I have a free demo available that goes up to drawing a triangle, while I'm still working on the rest of the game. You don't start from logic gates. The game starts with adders and comparators. Every wire just carries a fixed point number, and there are no bit widths to think about. The reason of using fixed point numbers is that veteran players of Turing Complete can skip the bits part they already player, while players who are new to programming can still jump right in. The circuit simulator is written in Go and the game UI is written in Godot, and they communitate through stdio. I also built a score server that players can upload their scores and compare with each other through score histograms. The demo is available on Steam (Windows/macOS/Linux), there's also an itch.io build if you don't use Steam. Curious what you think, and where you get stuck!

Upload a WAV/MP3 or paste a Suno link: it maps tempo, sections and lyrics, plans a storyboard you can edit, then renders scenes that cut on the beat. Free storyboard + chorus preview. No real people, no face swaps.

projects.summary: Sidefoot is the clubhouse for your pickup soccer career. Paste the score from your group chat and the Match Official logs it. Your crew gets a league table ranked by points per game, you get a career card, and you can find a crew that plays every week.

projects.title: Show HN: Four bite-sized chess puzzle games built on micro-boards
projects.author: navalsaini
projects.summary: Most chess apps try to replicate the classic 64-square experience. Over the last few years, I’ve been doing the opposite—breaking chess down into fast, bite-sized mobile games on smaller boards, each designed to isolate and gamify a single skill: Firstchess: Bite-sized lessons to learn the fundamentals on a compact board. Halfchess: Focused purely on endgame thinking on a smaller grid. Phantom Chess: Blind/memory-based chess on a mini board. Schmess: Real-time speed chess where multiple pieces move simultaneously. You can try all four live apps at https://halfchess.com . I plan to build more chess/poker mini games if I can figure out a distribution for these. If you know any media outlets or micro influencers who can cover my games, do let me know.

projects.title: Cozy Garden
projects.summary: Grow your own little pixel-art garden. Plant seeds, watch crops grow in real time, and harvest them to earn coins and XP. Unlock achievements, explore different crops, and build a garden that's uniquely yours. Features: - Plant and grow multiple types of crops - Watch crops progress through growth stages - Harvest for coins and experience points - Buy seeds from the in-game shop - Unlock achievements and track your progress - Explore player profiles and leaderboards

projects.title: SmartPoster

projects.title: Launchproof

Connect Claude and it works inside your coaching account: 134 tools that create clients, build programs from your exercise library, draft broadcasts, and set up lead funnels. Your clients get a real app: workouts as a full-screen vertical video deck, an AI assistant inside, you in the chat. Free for 3 clients, then a flat $49/month. No per-client fees.

projects.title: MyBodyiQ
projects.summary: Track meals, calories, macros, hydration, exercise, weight, medications, appointments, and health goals with MyBodyiQ.

projects.title: KesPrep
projects.summary: KesPrep looks across your public Chess.com or Lichess games to find recurring mistakes, then points you to positions from your own games to study. Stockfish evaluates the moves; KesPrep turns the results into a training focus. It is free during early access, and you can try it without creating an account.

projects.title: RPG Haven
projects.summary: RPG Haven makes finding your next tabletop RPG group easier. Browse games, meet fellow players, and apply to join campaigns near you or online. Whether you play D&D, Pathfinder, Call of Cthulhu, or something more obscure, find your next adventure or the players for your own game.

projects.title: Niche Dance Move AI Video Generator
projects.summary: Animate one photo with Low-key Groove, Heel-toe Bounce or Arm Frames. Preview each dance and compare its source photo, then choose Basic or Pro, resolution and optional music. Check the live credit quote before generating, review the result and download your AI dance video. Built with Viral Video AI; motion and likeness can vary.

projects.title: Fellmark
projects.summary: Fellmark is a fantasy steampunk survival game on smooth voxel ground about two kilometres deep, and all of it can be dug. Mine ore veins, smelt and forge thirteen metals from copper to voidstone, build from the foundations up, survive the cold and the dark, sail the fjords, and in the endgame build automated factories. It's in closed testing on Windows, with online co-op and offline single-player. There's a free demo on itch.io with no time limit.

projects.title: Recipians: Daily Recipe App
projects.summary: Discover your next favorite meal with Recipians — 40,000+ recipes, personalized daily suggestions, step-by-step cooking, nutrition info, and an optional personal health log. Whether you know what to cook or need inspiration, Recipians finds meals that match your tastes, ingredients, dietary preferences, and the moment. Explore 40,000+ recipes across cuisines, ingredients, meal types, and diets — Indian, Thai, Italian, Mexican, breakfasts, dinners, snacks, desserts, vegetarian dishes, and more.

projects.title: MaxBot
projects.summary: MaxBot pushes your Twitch subs, VIPs and mods into Discord roles the moment they change, and takes the role off when a sub lapses. It also runs a watch-time economy with 15 games that work in Twitch chat and Discord, automod, custom commands, timed messages and stream overlays you lay out in a visual editor. It's hosted, so it keeps running when your PC is off, and one account runs every channel you're part of. Free to start; paid tiers from $5 a month.

projects.title: 球X (QIUX.AI)
projects.summary: 球X（QIUX.AI）是一款面向全球足球爱好者的 AI 体育智能与球迷社交平台，致力于将实时比分、专业赛事数据、AI 智能分析和全球球迷社区融为一体。 在球X，用户可以实时追踪全球足球赛事、查看比赛比分与球队数据，使用自主打造的垂直体育 AI 助手获取赛前分析、赛事研判和数据洞察。每场比赛都拥有专属讨论空间，让球迷分享观点、交流战术、参与赛事预测，并在赛后共同复盘。 我们希望改变传统体育平台单向获取信息的体验，让每一场比赛不仅值得观看，更值得分析、讨论和参与。 QIUX.AI 不只是一个比分网站，而是 AI 体育智能与足球社交社区的结合。 无论你是资深足球迷、赛事数据爱好者，还是喜欢与全球球迷交流的体育用户，都欢迎加入球X。 探索球X，开启全新的足球体验 🌐 https://qiux.ai

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Senrelay（续境）：本地优先的 macOS 多 Agent 会话接力与 15 宿主配置工作台
projects.author: qingsongcui

github.name: qingsongcui/ContextCore
github.description: Senrelay · 续境 — Local-first macOS multi-Agent conversation relay, source-linked persistent memory, and unified host configuration workbench.

projects.summary: GitHub 开源协议：MIT（完全免费、无需登录账号、零遥测） 平时高强度用 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Cursor 和 OpenCode 写代码，经常被两件琐事卡住： 1. 额度见底或切换工具时上下文断层：在 Claude Code 里排查完一半的问题，切到 Codex 或 Cursor 又得重新解释背景，很多贴进剪贴板的“自动摘要”还会把关键错误日志或边界条件丢掉； 2. 多宿主配置越改越乱：不同工具的 MCP JSON、TOML 和规则文件路径各不相同，手动修改很容易写坏原有字段或互相覆盖。 所以做了 Senrelay · 续境（ContextCore） —— 一个本地优先（local-first）的 macOS 原生多 Agent 工作台： 单指令跨工具原文接力（/contextcore）：在任意新工具里输入 /contextcore（或直接说“接着做”），先返回简短不掉帧的会话候选表（保留 Git Worktree 分支消歧）；选定后由接手 Agent 通过 readconversationmessages 按预算分页读取原始对话在本地压缩续写，支持“仅复盘待命（mustnotexecute=true）”与 discussiononly 防误改护栏。 双层工作记忆与原文溯源：区分当前任务状态（workingtasks）与长期规范/经验（contents），所有记忆绑定原话引用并支持冲突检测与版本回滚。 15 个编码宿主的事务化配置管理：内置 6 个核心上下文宿主 + 9 个扩展宿主的原生路径解析与结构化写入（支持 JSON / JSONC / JSON5 / TOML / YAML），写入前自动落盘备份快照；本地 FTS5 全文检索（默认不下载外部模型，完全运行在 127.0.0.1）。 安装与适用边界说明 当前 Public Beta（v1.0.0-beta.2）仅支持 Apple Silicon（arm64）macOS 14.0+（Windows/Linux 暂不支持）；安装包采用本地 ad-hoc 签名，首次打开前清一次下载隔离属性即可： bash brew install --cask qingsongcui/tap/senrelay xattr -cr /Applications/Senrelay.app 在线速查文档：15 个 AI 编程宿主配置路径与安全写入规则 实战工作流说明：跨 Agent 会话接力与额度交接指南

projects.title: Balak City
projects.summary: Balak City is a free open-world city game you play right in the browser or inside Telegram, no download. Build a gang, buy houses, hotels, factories and the port, take neighborhoods from rival gangs, fly planes and helicopters, escape the police and join the City Vault heist with other players in real time. It runs on Solana: every in-game coin is backed 1:1 by stablecoins in a public vault and players can cash out to their own wallet. Available in English, Spanish and Portuguese.
